country: 日本
synopsis: ふたりの少年の30年にわたる友情と再会を通して、人が生きることの意味を静かに問いかけた長編アニメーション映画。 平成の日本の田舎町。自分が“普通”であることに悩む小学3年生の内気な少年・翼は、クラスの人気者で“特別”な存在である暁太郎と出会い、親友になる。ふたりだけの遊びや意味のない会話、夕暮れの帰り道など、小さな世界の中でかけがえのない時間を過ごす翼と暁太郎だったが、日常は少しずつ歪みはじめる。暁太郎はクラスの中で浮いた存在となり、噂や視線が彼を囲むようになる。翼はその変化に気づきながらも、何も言えず、何もしないという選択を重ねてしまう。やがて取り返しのつかない事件が起こり、ふたりの関係は大きく変わっていく。 YOASOBI「優しい彗星」のMVなどを手がけたアニメーション作家・門脇康平が長編初監督を務め、緻密な世界観と写実的な映像表現で描き出す。“普通”の青年・翼役で坂東龍汰、“特別”な存在の暁太郎役で岡山天音が声優を務め、オーディションで選ばれた槙木悠人と中込佑玖が幼少期の翼と暁太郎の声をそれぞれ担当。音楽プロデューサーのYaffleが音楽を手がけた。2026年・第39回東京国際映画祭「アニメーション」部門上映作品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 小学三年生の夏、内気な少年のつばさは、クラスの人気者である暁太郎と出会い、親友になる。小さな世界の中で、かけがえのない時間を過ごしていくふたり。しかし、ある些細な事件をきっかけに、ふたりの関係は引き裂かれて——。  30年以上にわたる少年たちの友情と再会を通して、人が生きることの意味を静かに問いかける物語。
tmdb_overview_en: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: "Pipiro rirori ro. Secret mission on Earth complete. Returning to space!" In a certain rural town in the Heisei era, Tsubasa, a shy boy troubled by being "ordinary," meets Akitaro, the class idol and a "special" presence, in the spring of his third year of elementary school, and they become best friends. Games just for the two of them, meaningless conversations, the walk home at dusk—— The world was certainly theirs. But from a certain day onward, Akitaro became an outcast in the class, and rumors and stares surrounded him. Eventually, an irreversible incident occurs. "Hey, what would you do if I were an alien?" Is this a coming-of-age story of two people, or a memory they want to erase? A story of a friendship spanning 30 years, an endlessly blue tale of departure——

cinema_name: ヒューマントラストシネマ渋谷
cinema_address: 東京都渋谷区渋谷1-23-16 ココチビル 7・8F
country: 日本
synopsis: 「ミッシング」「空白」「ヒメアノ～ル」の𠮷田恵輔が監督・脚本を手がけ、過去に囚われたまま大人になった2人の青年と、彼らの運命を狂わせていく「メンター（助言者）」の存在を描いた人間ドラマ。 ある日、龍之介と拓海という2人の少年の無邪気な花火遊びが、アパート火災を引き起こした。アパートは全焼し、巻き込まれた住人の埜本は妻子を失い自身も全身に火傷を負った。その日を境に、龍之介と拓海の時間は止まってしまう。15年後、龍之介は罪の意識に蓋をし、アーチェリーのオリンピック日本代表候補として前に進もうとしていた。その一方で、拓海は罪の記憶から抜け出せず、陰鬱な日々を過ごしていた。そんな2人の前に、埜本が突然姿を現す。2人に恨みの言葉をぶつけることもなく優しく接する埜本に、龍之介はどこか違和感を抱き、拓海は救いの光を見いだす。やがて埜本は、拓海にとって心の拠りどころとなるメンターのような存在となっていく。 「ヤクザと家族 The Family」「月」などの磯村勇斗が龍之介役、アイドルグループ「Aぇ！ group」のメンバーで本作が個人として初の映画主演となる末澤誠也が拓海役で主演を務め、物語の鍵を握るメンターの埜本役で綾野剛が共演。
tmdb_overview_jp: 15年前の夏に起きたある火災事故から始まる。少年の無邪気な花火遊びがアパートを全焼させ、黒焦げの妻を抱えた男・埜本（のもと）が、燃えさかるアパートの一室から姿を現す。あまりにも強烈な記憶を前に、当事者であった少年たち——龍之介と拓海の時間は、あの日を境に止まってしまった。  やがて大人になった二人は、まったく異なる道を歩んでいる。龍之介（磯村勇斗）は罪に蓋をし、アーチェリーのオリンピック日本代表候補として前へ進もうとする。一方、拓海（末澤誠也）はいまだ罪の記憶から抜け出せず、陰鬱な日々に立ちすくんでいた。そんな二人の前に、あの火傷の男・埜本が再び現れる。しかし彼は恨みの言葉を口にすることなく、「君はもう、充分に償ったよ」と静かに語りかける。不気味なほどに優しいその姿は、やがて彼らにとっての “mentor／メンター”（助言者・導き手）となっていく——。
tmdb_overview_en: Fifteen years ago, an innocent fireworks accident caused by two boys, Ryunosuke and Takumi, destroyed an apartment building. One resident, Nomoto, lost his wife and child in the fire and suffered severe burns across his body. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke tries to live a "normal" life while suppressing his guilt, whereas Takumi remains emotionally trapped in the past. When Nomoto suddenly reappears before them, the expected confrontation never comes. Instead, he shows an unsettling kindness—one that deeply disturbs Ryunosuke, yet offers a fragile sense of salvation to Takumi. As their paths cross once again in a reunion that should never have happened, the lives of these three individuals begin to shift in ways that will irrevocably alter their futures.
synopsis_en: A human drama directed and written by Keisuke Yoshida of "Missing," "Blank," and "Himeanole," depicting two young men who grew up trapped by their past and the "mentor" figure who sends their fates spiraling. One day, two boys named Ryunosuke and Takumi's innocent fireworks play causes an apartment fire. The apartment burns to the ground, and a resident caught in the blaze, Nomoto, loses his wife and child and suffers burns over his entire body. From that day on, time stops for Ryunosuke and Takumi. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke has sealed away his guilt and is trying to move forward as a candidate for Japan's Olympic archery team. Takumi, meanwhile, cannot escape the memory of his sin and lives out gloomy days. Suddenly, Nomoto appears before the two. Ryunosuke feels a sense of unease at Nomoto's gentle treatment of them, without ever hurling words of resentment, while Takumi finds a glimmer of salvation. Eventually, Nomoto becomes a mentor-like figure and emotional anchor for Takumi. Hayato Isomura of "Yakuza and the Family" and "Moon" plays Ryunosuke, and Seiya Suezawa, a member of the idol group "Ae! group" making his first solo film lead, plays Takumi, with Go Ayano co-starring as the mentor Nomoto, who holds the key to the story.

cinema_name: ヒューマントラストシネマ渋谷
cinema_address: 東京都渋谷区渋谷1-23-16 ココチビル 7・8F
director: ハリス・ディキンソン
country: イギリス
synopsis:
俳優としてのキャリアを築きながら、映画監督という夢を抱いていたハリス・ディキンソンは、 彼が実際に依存者や路上生活者の支援団体をサポートしてきた経験からテーマの着想を得た。 「社会の隙間に落ちた人々」と「そこから抜け出せない社会システム」を描きながら、 善意や教訓を押し付けずあくまで"観察"に徹したハリスの眼差しが、ジレンマから抜け出せない人々の、どうしようもない、でも目が離せない人生を、ユーモラスに浮かび上がらせる。
ロンドンの路上で暮らすマイクは、今日も通行人に小銭をせびったり、炊き出しに並んだりと忙しい。 そんなある日、親切にしてくれた男性から衝動的に金品を奪い、逮捕されてしまう。 出所後は再生を誓うも、順調な生活はふとした拍子に脆く崩れていく。転落真っ只中のマイクを待つのは破滅か、それとも・・・！？
tmdb_overview_en: Mike, a rough sleeper in London, is trapped in a cycle of self-destruction as he attempts to turn his life around. Along the way, he encounters unexpected chances for a fresh start.
director_jp: ハリス・ディキンソン
synopsis_en: Harris Dickinson, who was building a career as an actor while harboring a dream of becoming a film director, drew inspiration for the theme from his own experience supporting organizations that help addicts and homeless people. While depicting 'people who have fallen through the cracks of society' and 'the social systems that keep them from escaping,' Harris's gaze—devoted purely to 'observation' without imposing goodwill or moral lessons—humorously brings to the surface the hopeless yet impossible-to-look-away lives of people trapped in dilemmas. Mike, who lives on the streets of London, is busy again today begging passersby for change and lining up at soup kitchens. Then one day, on impulse, he robs a man who had been kind to him and is arrested. After his release he vows to turn his life around, but his stable life crumbles fragilely at the slightest turn. Will ruin await Mike, who is in the midst of his downward spiral, or...!?

cinema_name: ホワイト シネクイント
country: 日本
synopsis: 直木賞受賞作家・千早茜が2014年に発表した同名小説を、「幼な子われらに生まれ」の三島有紀子監督が実写映画化。30歳を前に人生に行き詰まった女性が男友達と過ごす3つの夜を通して、ひとりの女性の清濁まざり合った心情と、言葉にできない男女の関係性を描く。 京都に暮らす29歳のイラストレーター・神名（かんな）は仕事もプライベートも順調に見えるが、実際は人生に静かな行き詰まりを感じていた。絵本で賞を獲り脚光を浴びてから歳月が経ち、近頃は無茶なクライアントワークに神経をすり減らしながら、惰性と不毛な恋愛に逃げる日々を過ごしている。そんなある日、神名は大学時代の先輩である男友達のハセオからの思いがけない電話をきっかけに、7年ぶりに彼と再会する。昔から自分勝手で人間関係に不器用なことを自覚している神名だったが、ハセオは出会った頃から彼女のことをなぜか深く理解してくれる存在だった。かつてと変わらない温度で接してくれるハセオと過ごす3つの夜は、神名の人生を大きく変えていく。 「勝手にふるえてろ」の松岡茉優が神名役で主演を務め、「愛がなんだ」の成田凌がハセオ役で共演。「アンダーカレント」「ちひろさん」などの澤井香織が脚本を担当。2026年・第39回東京国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、成田凌が最優秀男優賞受賞を受賞した。
tmdb_overview_en: Kanna is an illustrator living in Kyoto. Three nights with Haseo, a "guy friend" she reunites with after seven years, change the course of her life.
synopsis_en: A live-action adaptation of the Naoki Prize-winning author Akane Chihaya's 2014 novel of the same name, directed by Yukiko Mishima of 'Dear Etranger.' Through three nights a woman spends with a male friend as she hits a wall in life just before turning 30, the film depicts one woman's mixed feelings of purity and impurity, and the unspoken relationships between men and women. Kanna, a 29-year-old illustrator living in Kyoto, appears to have everything going well in both work and private life, but in reality she feels a quiet sense of being stuck in life. Years have passed since she won an award for a picture book and rose to prominence, and lately she wears down her nerves on unreasonable client work while escaping into inertia and fruitless romance. One day, an unexpected phone call from Haseo, a male friend who was her senior in college, leads Kanna to reunite with him for the first time in seven years. Kanna has always been aware that she is selfish and clumsy at relationships, but Haseo has somehow understood her deeply since the day they met. The three nights she spends with Haseo, who treats her with the same warmth as before, greatly change Kanna's life. Mayu Matsuoka of 'Tremble All You Want' stars as Kanna, with Ryo Narita of 'Love Is Hard for Otaku'—wait, 'Just Only Love'—as Haseo. Kaori Sawai of 'Under the Current' and 'Chihiro-san' wrote the screenplay. It was entered in the Competition section of the 39th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2026, where Ryo Narita won the Best Actor Award.

cinema_name: ホワイト シネクイント
country: アメリカ 原題または英題：Backrooms
synopsis: インターネット発の都市伝説「バックルームズ」をモチーフに、ある日突然“現実世界の裏側”へ迷い込んでしまった男の恐怖を描き、世界各地で社会現象を巻き起こした不条理スリラー。16歳の時に発表したYouTube短編動画「The Backrooms （Found Footage）」で注目を集めた映像クリエイターのケイン・パーソンズが、同短編をもとに映画化を企画、19歳で撮影を行い、全米・世界興収ランキングでそれぞれ公開初週1位の映画を生んだ史上最年少の監督となった。 家具店の店主クラークは、店内に“あるはずのない隙間”を発見する。その先には壁の裏側へと抜け落ちるように続く、全面が黄色い壁紙の異様な空間が広がっていた。奇妙なバランスで積み上げられた無数の家具に、果てしなく続く迷路のような黄色い部屋。どこからともなく断片的なアナウンスが聞こえてくるが、呼びかけても応答はない。クラークはセラピストのメアリーにこの異様な空間について説明したものの信じてもらえず、その存在を証明するべく、記録用のビデオカメラを手に再び足を踏み入れるが……。 「それでも夜は明ける」のキウェテル・イジョフォーが主演を務め、「センチメンタル・バリュー」のレナーテ・レインスベ、「スキャンダル」のマーク・デュプラス、ドラマ「ナイト・オブ・ザ・セブン・キングダムズ」のフィン・ベネットが共演。110分の本編終了後に16分のスペシャル映像を追加した「Everything Must Go Edition」も制作され、日本では同バージョンにて劇場公開。
tmdb_overview_jp: 舞台は、都市伝説とされていた空間“Backrooms”。「ある日突然 “現実世界の裏側”へ墜ちてしまったら…？」どこまでも続く黄色い壁紙の部屋、終わりのない廊下。不自然な間取りと、意味を失い床に埋まった設置物。  わずかに現実からズレている――そんな出口のない“リミナルスペース”で、観客は“最高密度の不安と恐怖”を体験する。
tmdb_overview_en: A strange doorway appears in the basement of a furniture showroom.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: An absurdist thriller inspired by the internet-born urban legend 'The Backrooms,' depicting the terror of a man who one day stumbles into the 'backside of the real world,' sparking a global social phenomenon. Kane Parsons, the video creator who gained attention at 16 for his YouTube short 'The Backrooms (Found Footage),' planned this film adaptation based on that short, shot it at 19, and became the youngest director ever to have a film debut at #1 at the US and worldwide box office. Clarke, the owner of a furniture store, discovers a 'gap that shouldn't exist' in his shop. Beyond it lies a bizarre space covered entirely in yellow wallpaper, as if falling through to the other side of the wall. Countless pieces of furniture stacked in strange balance, endless maze-like yellow rooms. Fragmentary announcements can be heard from somewhere, but there is no response to calls. Clarke explains this strange space to his therapist, Mary, but she doesn't believe him. To prove its existence, he ventures back in with a video camera to record, but... Chiwetel Ejiofor ('12 Years a Slave') stars, with Renate Reinsve ('The Worst Person in the World'), Mark Duplass ('Bombshell'), and Finn Bennett ('Game of Thrones' spinoff 'A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms') co-starring. An 'Everything Must Go Edition' with 16 minutes of special footage added after the 110-minute main feature was also produced and released theatrically in Japan.

cinema_name: ホワイト シネクイント
country: 韓国 原題または英題：3670
synopsis: 脱北者でゲイであるという「二重のマイノリティ」を生きる若者の姿を通して、韓国に暮らす脱北者の日常と葛藤、ゲイとして生きる不安や戸惑いを描いたヒューマンドラマ。 北朝鮮から脱北したゲイの青年チョルジュンは、脱北者同士の強い絆に支えられながらも、自身がゲイであることを隠したまま深い孤独を抱えていた。韓国社会にも脱北者コミュニティにも完全には居場所を見出せずにいた彼は、やがてソウルの活気あるゲイコミュニティに足を踏み入れ、人懐っこい青年ヨンジュンと出会う。ヨンジュンとの関係をきっかけに、初めての仲間、初めてのつながりを得ながら、少しずつ世界を広げていくチョルジュンだったが……。 短編映画や演劇の舞台を中心に活動してきたチョ・ユヒョンが長編映画初主演を果たし、主人公チョルジュンを繊細な感情表現と静かな存在感で体現。「私たちは天国には行けないけど、愛することはできる」のキム・ヒョンモクがヨンジュンを演じた。本作が長編デビューとなるパク・ジュンホ監督が、大学時代に約3年半にわたり経験した、脱北した若者たちへの支援ボランティアに着想を得て制作。2026年・第62回百想芸術大賞映画部門で新人監督賞を受賞するなど、韓国国内外で高く評価された。
tmdb_overview_en: Despite the close bonds among fellow defectors, Cheol-jun—a young North Korean defector—felt isolated while hiding his gay identity. Finally, he takes his first step into South Korea's vibrant gay community and forms close ties after meeting Yeong-jun at a casual gathering. Yet, a trivial misunderstanding shatters these fragile bonds.
synopsis_en: A human drama depicting the daily life and struggles of North Korean defectors living in South Korea, as well as the anxieties and confusion of living as a gay man, through the eyes of a young person living as a "double minority"—both a defector and gay. Chul-jun, a gay young man who defected from North Korea, is supported by the strong bonds among fellow defectors, yet hides his sexuality and carries deep loneliness within. Unable to find a true place for himself in either South Korean society or the defector community, he eventually steps into Seoul's vibrant gay community and meets the friendly young man Yong-jun. Through his relationship with Yong-jun, Chul-jun gains his first companions and first genuine connections, gradually expanding his world—but then... Jo Yu-hyun, who has primarily worked in short films and theater, makes his feature film debut in the lead role, embodying protagonist Chul-jun with delicate emotional expression and quiet presence. Kim Hyun-mok of "We Can't Go to Heaven, But We Can Love" plays Yong-jun. Director Park Jun-ho, making his feature debut, was inspired by his experience volunteering for about three and a half years during university to support young North Korean defectors. The film won the Best New Director award in the film category at the 62nd Baeksang Arts Awards in 2026, among other high acclaim in South Korea and abroad.

synopsis: 「WEAPONS ウェポンズ」のザック・クレッガー監督が、世界的人気を誇るカプコンのホラーゲーム「バイオハザード」シリーズを新たに映画化したサバイバルホラー。同ゲームシリーズの熱烈なファンであるクレッガー監督が、「もしもゲーム『バイオハザード』の世界に放り込まれたらどうなるか？」をコンセプトにストーリーを再構築。ゲームへのオマージュをちりばめながら、医療品の配達人を襲う地獄のような一夜を描き出す。 医療品の配達人として働くブライアンは、とある病院で「取扱注意」と記された医療バッグを託され、ラクーンシティ総合病院へ向かうことになる。いつも通り車を走らせるブライアンだったが、路上に飛び出してきた血まみれの女に衝突したことから事態は急展開。想像を絶する事態に次々と見舞われ、命がけのサバイバルに巻き込まれていく。 「WEAPONS ウェポンズ」にも出演したオースティン・エイブラムスが主人公ブライアンを演じ、テレビドラマ「セヴェランス」のザック・チェリー、プロボクサーで俳優のカーリー・レイス、「リチャード・ジュエル」のポール・ウォルター・ハウザーが共演。「ジョン・ウィック」シリーズの脚本家シェイ・ハッテンがクレッガー監督と共同で脚本を担当。
tmdb_overview_jp: ある医療品の配送を請け負った男を襲う、地獄の一夜。 男は、己の命運を懸けた壮絶なサバイバルを余儀なくされる…
tmdb_overview_en: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: A survival horror film in which director Zach Cregger of Weapons newly adapts Capcom's globally popular horror game series Resident Evil for the screen. Cregger, a passionate fan of the game series, rebuilt the story around the concept of "What would happen if you were thrown into the world of the game Resident Evil?" While scattering homages to the games throughout, it depicts a hellish night that befalls a medical supplies delivery worker. Brian, who works delivering medical supplies, is entrusted at a certain hospital with a medical bag marked "Handle with Care" and is to head to Raccoon City General Hospital. Driving as usual, Brian's situation takes a sudden turn when he collides with a blood-soaked woman who darts out into the road. Beset one after another by unimaginable circumstances, he is dragged into a life-or-death survival struggle. Austin Abrams, who also appeared in Weapons, plays the protagonist Brian, with Zach Cherry of the TV drama Severance, professional boxer and actor Kallie Reis, and Paul Walter Hauser of Richard Jewell co-starring. Shay Hatten, a screenwriter of the John Wick series, co-wrote the script with director Cregger.

synopsis: 2020年2月に開始された毎日新聞による調査報道「特権を問う」の内容を軸に、日米地位協定がもたらす「米軍特権」の実態を浮き彫りにしたドキュメンタリー。東京・六本木の米軍施設・赤坂プレスセンターと、東京西部にある横田基地、そして基地が集中する沖縄を主な舞台に、全4章で構成。 第1章「日本の空は誰のものなのか」は、東京上空を飛び交う米軍ヘリの問題に迫った調査報道をもとに、過去に町田市や沖縄国際大学で起きた事故なども織り交ぜながら、戦後81年を迎えても変わらないこの国の姿をあぶり出す。第2章「誰が犯人を逃がしているのか？」では日米密約の問題をひもとき、米兵による性暴力と日本政府の姿勢を見つめる。第3章「米軍基地は誰のためにあるのか？」では基地問題と向き合う市民たちの思いに耳を傾けて、終章「星条旗と日本人」へとつなげ、日米同盟の名の下で放置されてきたこの国の“当たり前”を問い直していく。 「春画と日本人」「わたしたちの国立西洋美術館　奇跡のコレクションの舞台裏」などのドキュメンタリー作品で知られる大墻敦が監督を務め、毎日新聞の記者と共に約2年にわたり取材を重ねて映画として完成させた。
tmdb_overview_jp: 首都上空を飛び交う米軍ヘリの実態に迫った調査報道をベースに、  毎日新聞が初めて送り出す長編ドキュメンタリー映画。
tmdb_overview_en: An investigative documentary examining the privileged status of the U.S. military in Japan, based on reporting by the Mainichi Shimbun. Focusing on low-altitude U.S. military helicopter flights over Tokyo, the film investigates the Japan–U.S. Status of Forces Agreement, the handling of crimes involving U.S. service members, and the impact of military bases on local communities. Through reporting from Tokyo, Yokota Air Base, and Okinawa, it questions the long-standing assumptions underlying the U.S.–Japan alliance and asks who truly controls Japan's skies.
synopsis_en: A documentary that sheds light on the reality of "U.S. military privileges" brought about by the Japan-U.S. Status of Forces Agreement, centered on the Mainichi Shimbun's investigative reporting series "Questioning Privilege," which began in February 2020. Set primarily in Tokyo's Roppongi at the U.S. military facility Akasaka Press Center, Yokota Air Base in western Tokyo, and Okinawa where bases are concentrated, the film is structured in four chapters. Chapter 1, "Whose Sky Is Japan's?" draws on investigative reporting that confronted the issue of U.S. military helicopters flying over Tokyo, interweaving past accidents in Machida City and at Okinawa International University to expose the unchanged state of this country even 81 years after the war. Chapter 2, "Who Is Letting the Culprits Escape?" unravels the issue of secret Japan-U.S. agreements and examines sexual violence by U.S. soldiers and the Japanese government's response. Chapter 3, "For Whom Do U.S. Bases Exist?" listens to the thoughts of citizens confronting base issues, leading into the final chapter, "The Stars and Stripes and the Japanese," which questions the "normalcy" that has been left unaddressed in the name of the Japan-U.S. alliance. Directed by Atsushi Oshiro, known for documentaries such as "Shunga and the Japanese" and "Our National Museum of Western Art: Behind the Scenes of a Miraculous Collection," who spent approximately two years conducting interviews alongside Mainichi Shimbun reporters to complete the film.

synopsis: 韓国・済州島で1940年代から50年代にかけて起きた「済州4・3」事件での虐殺を生き延びた4人の証言を通して、闇に覆われてきた女性たちの被害と苦難の道のりを明らかにしたドキュメンタリー。 1947年3月1日から54年9月21日までの7年7カ月にわたり、済州島の島民が国家権力により“赤狩り”の名目で弾圧され、推定2万5千人から3万人が死亡したとされる「済州4・3」事件。この惨劇は軍事政権下で隠蔽され続け、50年近い歳月を経た2000年にようやく真相究明と犠牲者の名誉回復がなされることとなった。しかし、犠牲者の2割を占めた女性たちが受けた性暴力被害は積極的に語られることなく、その証言が可視化されるようになったのは2019年になってからだった。 本作では、「済州4・3」事件の研究者による聞き取り作業に同行し、生き延びた4人の女性の証言を軸に、国家権力と家父長制という二重の暴力にさらされた女性たちの苦難を描き出す。企画・プロデュースを務めたのは、韓国のテレビ局で40年以上にわたりドキュメンタリー番組制作に携わってきたキム・オギョン。監督は「アングリーバードとバナナ合唱団」のドキュメンタリー作家チ・ヘウォン。2024年・第25回全州国際映画祭で特別部門ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
synopsis_en: A documentary that reveals the suffering and ordeals of women who have been shrouded in darkness, through the testimony of four survivors of the massacres of the Jeju 4·3 Incident that occurred on Jeju Island, South Korea, from the 1940s to the 1950s. The Jeju 4·3 Incident refers to the seven years and seven months from March 1, 1947, to September 21, 1954, during which islanders were suppressed by state power under the pretext of the "Red Hunt," with an estimated 25,000 to 30,000 people killed. This tragedy was continuously covered up under military regimes, and only after nearly 50 years, in 2000, was the truth finally investigated and the victims' honor restored. However, the sexual violence suffered by women, who made up 20 percent of the victims, was not actively discussed, and it was not until 2019 that their testimony began to be made visible. In this film, accompanying a researcher of the Jeju 4·3 Incident in his interview work, and centering on the testimony of four surviving women, it depicts the hardships of women exposed to the dual violence of state power and patriarchy. The planner and producer is Kim O-gyeong, who was involved in documentary production at a South Korean television station for more than 40 years. The director is documentary filmmaker Ji Hye-won of "Angry Bird and the Banana Choir." It won the Special Section Documentary Award at the 25th Jeonju International Film Festival in 2024.

movie_title_jp: 私がまだ知らない沖縄
country: 日本
synopsis: 沖縄の島々に暮らす人たちの声から、沖縄と日本の関係を見つめ直したドキュメンタリー。 豊かな自然と温暖な気候に恵まれ、琉球王国時代から受け継がれてきた独自の文化・風習をもつ沖縄の島々。その一方で、戦争では20万人以上が犠牲となり、戦後も日本国内における米軍基地の約7割がこの地に集まり、県民所得は全国最下位で3人に1人の子どもが貧困状態にある。戦後81年、本土復帰54年を経た現在、沖縄では何が起こり、そこに暮らす人々は何を見つめ、どのような問題と向き合っているのか。10代から80代までの市井の人々の語りの集積から、沖縄の実像を重層的に浮かび上がらせていく。 監督は、大袈裟太郎という芸名でも知られるジャーナリストでラッパーの猪股東吾。東京から沖縄に移住して取材を続けるなかで、沖縄が抱えるさまざまな問題の根幹に「本土」側の無関心と構造的差別があることを実感した猪股監督が、「やまとんちゅ（本土出身者）」という立場から初メガホンをとり、4年の歳月をかけて完成させた。
synopsis_en: A documentary that reexamines the relationship between Okinawa and Japan through the voices of people living on Okinawa's islands. Blessed with rich nature and a warm climate, the islands of Okinawa possess a unique culture and customs inherited from the era of the Ryukyu Kingdom. On the other hand, more than 200,000 people lost their lives in the war, and even after the war, about 70% of the U.S. military bases in Japan are concentrated in this region, prefectural income is the lowest in the country, and one in three children lives in poverty. Now, 81 years after the war and 54 years after the reversion to the mainland, what is happening in Okinawa, what are the people living there gazing at, and what problems are they facing? Through the accumulation of testimonies from ordinary citizens ranging from their teens to their eighties, the true image of Okinawa is brought to light in multiple layers. The director is Togo Inomata, a journalist and rapper also known by the stage name Daikisho Taro. While continuing to interview after moving from Tokyo to Okinawa, Inomata came to realize that at the root of the various problems Okinawa faces lies the indifference and structural discrimination of the "mainland." From his position as a "Yamatonchu" (person from the mainland), he directed his first feature film, completing it over the course of four years.

synopsis: 人々の毎日の食卓の向こう側に生きる、全国の若い農家たちを4年にわたって取材したドキュメンタリー。 統計によると、49歳以下の農家は日本の人口のわずか0.1％にまで減少している。農業を取り巻く状況が年々厳しさを増していくなか、彼らは自分たちを「絶滅危惧種」であると笑いながら、さまざまな知恵と工夫で道を切り開こうとしている。土の中の微生物の力を引き出して週休1.5日を実現する有機農家。1億円の借金を抱えた大規模酪農から放牧へと舵をきり、牛を「適正規模」に減らすことで家族の笑顔を取り戻した酪農家の夫婦。マニュアルが通用しない理不尽な自然を相手に、若い農家たちは自らの創造力でタフに生き抜いていく。 「百姓の百の声」「千年の一滴　だし　しょうゆ」の柴田昌平監督が、生産現場の圧倒的な生命力と、消費社会の無知という“深い断絶”に迫り、再生へのヒントを見出していく。
synopsis_en: A documentary that spent four years interviewing young farmers across Japan who live on the other side of people's daily dinner tables. According to statistics, farmers aged 49 or younger have dwindled to just 0.1% of Japan's population. As the situation surrounding agriculture grows harsher year by year, they laugh and call themselves an endangered species while trying to carve a path forward with various forms of wisdom and ingenuity. An organic farmer who draws out the power of microorganisms in the soil and achieves a 1.5-day weekend. A dairy farming couple who, after shifting from large-scale dairy farming burdened by 100 million yen in debt to grazing and reducing their herd to an appropriate scale, regained their family's smiles. Facing unreasonable nature that no manual can address, young farmers survive toughly through their own creativity. Director Shohei Shibata of Hyakusho no Hyaku no Koe and Sennen no Itteki: Dashi, Shoyu confronts the overwhelming vitality of production sites and the deep divide of ignorance in consumer society, discovering hints for regeneration.

synopsis: 父親の故郷である中国湖北省の村に10年以上通い続け、村の記憶と自身の変化を記録してきたジャン・モンチー監督による「自画像 47KM」シリーズの第2作。村で亡くなった人々のための記念碑を建てようとする日々を追った。 2010年、大学を出たばかりのジャン・モンチーは、老人たちにインタビューをしようと「47KM村」と呼ばれる村を訪れ、村を襲った飢餓の記憶を聞き取り始める。約1年ぶりに村へ戻ってきた監督は、村で亡くなり忘れ去られようとしている人々のために記念碑を建てようと考える。反対の声を受けながらも1軒ずつ家を訪ね、賛同と寄付を募っていくが、詳しい聞き取りを重ねるうち、人々の証言が大きく食い違っていることに気づいていく。 監督のジャン・モンチーは1987年、中国湖北省生まれ。中央民族大学でダンスを学び、ダンサー、振付家として活動しながらドキュメンタリー制作を始めた。山形国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭が共催する「47KMシリーズ特集上映」（2026年11月7～20日＝ポレポレ東中野）でシリーズ全10本とともに上映され、本作は日本初上映となる。
synopsis_en: The second installment in director Zhang Mengqi's "Self-Portrait 47KM" series, in which she has continued to visit a village in Hubei Province, China—her father's hometown—for over ten years, documenting the village's memories and her own changes. The film follows her days attempting to build a monument for the people who died in the village. In 2010, fresh out of university, Zhang Mengqi visited the village called "47KM Village" to interview the elderly and began collecting accounts of the famine that struck the village. Returning to the village about a year later, the director decides to build a monument for the people who died there and are in danger of being forgotten. Despite opposition, she visits homes one by one, seeking support and donations, but as she conducts detailed interviews, she begins to notice that people's testimonies differ greatly. Director Zhang Mengqi was born in 1987 in Hubei Province, China. She studied dance at Minzu University of China and began making documentaries while working as a dancer and choreographer. The film is screened alongside all ten films in the series at the "47KM Series Special Screening" (November 7–20, 2026, at Pole Pole Higashi-Nakano), co-hosted by the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival, and this work marks its first screening in Japan.

synopsis: 性暴力をはじめ、さまざまな痛みを抱えながら生きるサバイバーたちにカメラを向けたドキュメンタリー。「阿賀に生きる」の撮影や「風の波紋」などの監督作で知られる小林茂がメガホンをとり、9年の歳月をかけて制作した。 友人が幼少期に受けた性虐待によるPTSDで長年苦しむ姿を見てきた小林茂監督は、性暴力からのサバイバーであることを公にしながら活動を続ける写真家との出会いをきっかけに、映画の制作を決意する。カメラは、それぞれ異なる痛みを抱えて生きるサバイバーたちへと向けられ、言葉にならない痛みとともに生きる姿をとらえていく。長期化する撮影のなかで、小林監督は映画を制作することの意義を問い、自分自身の過去と向き合うようになる。 「鉱 ARAGANE」「Underground アンダーグラウンド」などの映像作家・小田香が撮影を担当。2025年・第38回東京国際映画祭「Nippon Cinema Now」部門上映作品。
tmdb_overview_en: Sexual abuse has been characterized as a “murder of the spirit.” But is this a suffering that one person must bear alone? Beyond despair, there is hope, a faint ray of light from the spirit.  A friend of the filmmaker suffers from PTSD, having flashbacks of sexual abuse. Having witnessed this, the filmmaker meets a photographer who is also a survivor and decides to make a film. The long production process lasted eight years. What is the nature of the despair, and the hope, that reside deep within these people suffering from PTSD conditions including regret, murderous impulses, depression, insomnia, detachment, and suicidal thoughts? The director appears on screen, questioning the very meaning of making this film. He tries to see light in how they live, looking upward from the depths of suffering.
synopsis_en: A documentary that turns its camera on survivors living with various forms of pain, including sexual violence. Directed by Shigeru Kobayashi, known for his cinematography on Living on the River Agano and his directorial works such as Ripples of Wind, the film took nine years to complete. Having witnessed a friend suffer for years from PTSD caused by sexual abuse experienced in childhood, director Shigeru Kobayashi decided to make the film after meeting a photographer who continues her activities while publicly identifying as a survivor of sexual violence. The camera turns toward survivors each living with different pain, capturing how they live alongside pain that cannot be put into words. Over the long production period, Kobayashi comes to question the meaning of making the film and begins to confront his own past. Kaori Oda, a visual artist known for works such as ARAGANE and Underground, handled cinematography. An official selection in the Nippon Cinema Now section of the 38th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2025.

synopsis_en: A documentary that traces the footsteps of Kiyoshiro Imawano, who brought transformation to the Japanese music scene with love and rebellious spirit in his heart, and delves into the essence of his unparalleled expression. Debuting in 1970 as a member of the rock band RC Succession, Kiyoshiro Imawano produced numerous famous songs including "Ame Agari no Yozora ni," "Slow Ballad," and "Ikenai Rouge Magic." He also created numerous legends through his overwhelming live performances and left a tremendous legacy in Japanese rock history. Even after RC Succession went on hiatus in 1991, he pursued diverse expressive activities including solo work and music with THE TIMERS, as well as appearances in films and dramas, writing picture books, and even cycling. Always facing the times, he kept running throughout his life. This film, through carefully selected live footage and recording scenes from a vast archive, his sharp gaze toward society and the many incidents that caused public uproar, explores multi-faceted aspects of Imawano's one-of-a-kind performances and his "stance of sticking to his convictions," while also bringing to light his true image as a human being through scenes of Imawano himself speaking about the sources of his creativity. The director is Hiromi Aihara, known for "Tonovan: Musician Kazuhiko Kato and His Era."

synopsis: 愛と反骨を胸に日本の音楽シーンに変革をもたらした忌野清志郎の軌跡をたどり、その比類なき表現の真髄に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 ロックバンド「RCサクセション」のメンバーとして1970年にデビューし、「雨あがりの夜空に」「スローバラード」「い・け・な・いルージュマジック」など多くの名曲を世に送り出した忌野清志郎。その圧倒的なライブパフォーマンスでも数々の伝説を生み、日本のロック史に多大な功績を残した。1991年のRCサクセション活動休止後も、ソロや「THE TIMERS」での音楽活動に加え、映画・ドラマへの出演、絵本の執筆、さらにはサイクリストなど、多岐にわたる表現活動を展開。常に時代と向き合いながら、生涯にわたって走り続けた。 本作では、膨大なアーカイブから厳選されたライブ映像やレコーディング風景、社会への鋭いまなざしや世間を騒がせた数々の出来事など、忌野清志郎の唯一無二のパフォーマンスと“信念を貫く姿勢”を多面的に掘り下げるとともに、清志郎自らが創作の源泉について語る姿などを通して、ひとりの人間としての実像を浮かび上がらせていく。監督は「トノバン　音楽家　加藤和彦とその時代」の相原裕美。

synopsis: 2020年に起きた「京都ALS患者嘱託殺人事件」に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 2020年7月、ALS（筋萎縮性側索硬化症）を患う女性からの依頼で薬物を投与し殺害したとして、2人の医師が逮捕された。ひとり暮らしの彼女は事件当時は眼球しか動かせず、24時間の介護を必要としていた。主犯の大久保愉一は、女性が“安楽死”を望む言葉を投稿していたSNSで彼女と出会っており、事前に130万円の報酬を受け取り、初対面からわずか15分ほどで殺害を実行した。捜査により過去の殺人事件への関与も浮上するなか、メディアは大久保の過去のブログなどから、彼の生命軽視の姿勢を大々的に報じた。そして2025年、嘱託殺人罪などで懲役18年の刑が確定。救命が第一義とされるはずの医師が、なぜ一線を越えて彼女を手にかけたのか。 監督は、和歌山毒物カレー事件を検証した映画「マミー」の二村真弘。亡くなった女性の父親、SNS上での彼女を知る元看護師や難病当事者、医療とケアの専門家への取材を重ねて彼女の人生を掘り下げていくとともに、大久保の母親やかつての医師仲間のもとを訪ねてその半生をたどる。さらに大久保の供述分析を独自におこない、彼が収監されている大阪拘置所へと向かう。京都出身の俳優・田畑智子が声の出演を務め、亡くなった女性がインターネット上につづった切実な言葉の数々を代読。
tmdb_overview_jp: 2020年7月、ALS（筋萎縮性側索硬化症）を患う女性からの依頼で薬物を投与し殺害したとして、2人の医師が逮捕された。ひとり暮らしの彼女は事件当時は眼球しか動かせず、24時間の介護を必要としていた。主犯の大久保愉一は、女性が“安楽死”を望む言葉を投稿していたSNSで彼女と出会っており、事前に130万円の報酬を受け取り、初対面からわずか15分ほどで殺害を実行した。捜査により過去の殺人事件への関与も浮上するなか、メディアは大久保の過去のブログなどから、彼の生命軽視の姿勢を大々的に報じた。そして2025年、嘱託殺人罪などで懲役18年の刑が確定。救命が第一義とされるはずの医師が、なぜ一線を越えて彼女を手にかけたのか。

synopsis_en: A documentary that examines the 2020 "Kyoto ALS patient commissioned murder case." In July 2020, two doctors were arrested for administering drugs and killing a woman suffering from ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis) at her request. Living alone, she could move only her eyes at the time of the incident and required 24-hour care. The mastermind, Yuichi Okubo, had met her through social media where she posted words expressing her desire for "euthanasia"; he received a payment of 1.3 million yen in advance and carried out the killing within roughly 15 minutes of their first meeting. As the investigation brought to light his involvement in past murder cases, the media widely reported on his disregard for life based on his past blog posts and other writings. Then in 2025, his sentence of 18 years in prison was finalized for commissioned murder and other charges. Why did a doctor, whose foremost duty should be saving lives, cross the line and take her life? The director is Masahiro Nimura of "Mummy," which examined the Wakayama poison curry case. The film delves into her life through interviews with her father, a former nurse who knew her on social media, people living with intractable diseases, and experts in medicine and care, while also tracing Okubo's life by visiting his mother and former fellow doctors. It further conducts its own analysis of Okubo's statements and heads to the Osaka Detention House where he is incarcerated. Kyoto-born actress Tomoko Tabata provides voice performance, reading aloud the many poignant words the deceased woman wrote on the internet.

synopsis: 泉鏡花の小説を、歌舞伎俳優の坂東玉三郎主演、篠田正浩監督で映画化したスペクタクルファンタジー大作。越前・三国嶽の山中、竜神が封じ込められているという夜叉ヶ池。各地の不思議な物語を集めるため東京からこの地を訪れた萩原晃は、かつてこの地で50年間、鐘をつき続けてきたという老いた鐘楼守の弥太兵衛に会い、鐘にまつわる不思議な話を聞く。昔、人と水が戦い、この里が滅びようとした時、竜神を夜叉ヶ池に封じ込めたという。竜神を鎮めるために毎昼夜3度ずつ鐘を鳴らしていると話し、その日に弥太兵衛は死んだ。村人たちは鐘をつかないと竜が暴れだすという話に耳を貸そうとしなかったが、その時、美しい百合と知り合った晃は自身が第二の弥太兵衛になることを決心する。玉三郎が百合と夜叉ヶ池の竜神・白雪姫の二役を演じた。大規模な海外ロケ撮影や当時最先端の特撮技術を駆使して幻想的な世界観を生み出した。1979年に製作・公開。2021年7月、映像や音声が修復された4Kデジタルリマスター版がブルーレイ発売。あわせて「篠田正浩監督生誕90年祭『夜叉ヶ池』への道　モダニズム　ポップアート　そしてニッポン」（21年7月10日～、東京・ユーロスペース）で上映される。
tmdb_overview_jp: 越前の「夜叉ヶ池」には、竜神が棲んでいるという言い伝えがあった。そしてその竜神を鎮めるには、日に3度、鐘をつかなければならないという。しかし鐘つきの老人が死んだ時、その言い伝えを信じるものはいなかった。そしてついに、竜神が大洪水と共に甦る。
tmdb_overview_en: When a lone traveler stumbles upon a remote, drought-stricken village, he finds himself engulfed in a whirlpool of myth, mystery, and magic: in a nearby pond reside spirits who hold the fate of the town’s inhabitants, including lovers Akira and Yuri, in their hands.
synopsis_en: A spectacular fantasy epic adapted from Izumi Kyoka's novel, starring kabuki actor Tamasaburo Bando and directed by Masahiro Shinoda. In the mountains of Mikuni-dake in Echizen, there is Yasha Pond, where a dragon god is said to be sealed. Akira Hagiwara, who has come from Tokyo to collect strange tales from various regions, meets an old bell tower keeper named Yatahei who is said to have rung the bell continuously for fifty years, and hears the mysterious story of the bell. Long ago, when people and water fought and this village was on the verge of destruction, the dragon god was sealed in Yasha Pond. Yatahei explains that the bell is rung three times each day and night to pacify the dragon god, and that very day Yatahei dies. The villagers pay no heed to the story that the dragon will rampage if the bell is not rung, but at that moment Akira, who has met the beautiful Yuri, resolves to become the second Yatahei. Tamasaburo plays dual roles: Yuri and the dragon god of Yasha Pond, Princess Shirayuki. The film employed large-scale overseas location shooting and cutting-edge special effects of the time to create a fantastical worldview. Produced and released in 1979. In July 2021, a 4K digital remaster with restored image and sound was released on Blu-ray. It was also screened at "Director Masahiro Shinoda's 90th Birthday Festival: The Road to Yasha Pond — Modernism, Pop Art, and Japan" (from July 10, 2021, at Eurospace in Tokyo).

synopsis: 2020年に起きた「京都ALS患者嘱託殺人事件」に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 2020年7月、ALS（筋萎縮性側索硬化症）を患う女性からの依頼で薬物を投与し殺害したとして、2人の医師が逮捕された。ひとり暮らしの彼女は事件当時は眼球しか動かせず、24時間の介護を必要としていた。主犯の大久保愉一は、女性が“安楽死”を望む言葉を投稿していたSNSで彼女と出会っており、事前に130万円の報酬を受け取り、初対面からわずか15分ほどで殺害を実行した。捜査により過去の殺人事件への関与も浮上するなか、メディアは大久保の過去のブログなどから、彼の生命軽視の姿勢を大々的に報じた。そして2025年、嘱託殺人罪などで懲役18年の刑が確定。救命が第一義とされるはずの医師が、なぜ一線を越えて彼女を手にかけたのか。 監督は、和歌山毒物カレー事件を検証した映画「マミー」の二村真弘。亡くなった女性の父親、SNS上での彼女を知る元看護師や難病当事者、医療とケアの専門家への取材を重ねて彼女の人生を掘り下げていくとともに、大久保の母親やかつての医師仲間のもとを訪ねてその半生をたどる。さらに大久保の供述分析を独自におこない、彼が収監されている大阪拘置所へと向かう。京都出身の俳優・田畑智子が声の出演を務め、亡くなった女性がインターネット上につづった切実な言葉の数々を代読。

synopsis_en: A documentary that examines the 2020 "Kyoto ALS patient commissioned murder case." In July 2020, two doctors were arrested for administering drugs and killing a woman suffering from ALS (amyotrophic lateral sclerosis) at her request. Living alone, she could move only her eyes at the time of the incident and required 24-hour care. The mastermind, Yuichi Okubo, had met her through social media where she posted words expressing her desire for "euthanasia"; he received a payment of 1.3 million yen in advance and carried out the killing within roughly 15 minutes of their first meeting. As the investigation brought to light his involvement in past murder cases, the media widely reported on his disregard for life based on his past blog posts and other writings. Then in 2025, his sentence of 18 years in prison was finalized for commissioned murder and other charges. Why did a doctor, whose foremost duty should be saving lives, cross the line and take her life? The director is Masahiro Nimura of "Mummy," which examined the Wakayama poison curry case. The film delves into her life through interviews with her father, a former nurse who knew her on social media, people living with intractable diseases, and experts in medicine and care, while also tracing Okubo's life by visiting his mother and former fellow doctors. It further conducts its own analysis of Okubo's statements and heads to the Osaka Detention House where he is incarcerated. Kyoto-born actress Tomoko Tabata provides voice performance, reading aloud the many poignant words the deceased woman wrote on the internet.

tmdb_overview_en: Years of warfare end in a Japan unified under the Tokugawa shogunate, and samurai spy Sasuke Sarutobi, tired of conflict, longs for peace. When a high-ranking spy named Tatewaki Koriyama defects from the shogun to a rival clan, however, the world of swordsmen is thrown into turmoil. After Sasuke is unwittingly drawn into the conflict, he tracks Tatewaki, while a mysterious, white-hooded figure seems to hunt them both. By tale’s end, no one is who they seemed to be, and the truth is far more personal than anyone suspected. Director Masahiro Shinoda’s Samurai Spy, filled with clan intrigue, ninja spies, and multiple double crosses, marks a bold stylistic departure from swordplay film convention.

synopsis: 性暴力をはじめ、さまざまな痛みを抱えながら生きるサバイバーたちにカメラを向けたドキュメンタリー。「阿賀に生きる」の撮影や「風の波紋」などの監督作で知られる小林茂がメガホンをとり、9年の歳月をかけて制作した。 友人が幼少期に受けた性虐待によるPTSDで長年苦しむ姿を見てきた小林茂監督は、性暴力からのサバイバーであることを公にしながら活動を続ける写真家との出会いをきっかけに、映画の制作を決意する。カメラは、それぞれ異なる痛みを抱えて生きるサバイバーたちへと向けられ、言葉にならない痛みとともに生きる姿をとらえていく。長期化する撮影のなかで、小林監督は映画を制作することの意義を問い、自分自身の過去と向き合うようになる。 「鉱 ARAGANE」「Underground アンダーグラウンド」などの映像作家・小田香が撮影を担当。2025年・第38回東京国際映画祭「Nippon Cinema Now」部門上映作品。
tmdb_overview_en: Sexual abuse has been characterized as a “murder of the spirit.” But is this a suffering that one person must bear alone? Beyond despair, there is hope, a faint ray of light from the spirit.  A friend of the filmmaker suffers from PTSD, having flashbacks of sexual abuse. Having witnessed this, the filmmaker meets a photographer who is also a survivor and decides to make a film. The long production process lasted eight years. What is the nature of the despair, and the hope, that reside deep within these people suffering from PTSD conditions including regret, murderous impulses, depression, insomnia, detachment, and suicidal thoughts? The director appears on screen, questioning the very meaning of making this film. He tries to see light in how they live, looking upward from the depths of suffering.
synopsis_en: A documentary that turns its camera on survivors living with various forms of pain, including sexual violence. Directed by Shigeru Kobayashi, known for his cinematography on Living on the River Agano and his directorial works such as Ripples of Wind, the film took nine years to complete. Having witnessed a friend suffer for years from PTSD caused by sexual abuse experienced in childhood, director Shigeru Kobayashi decided to make the film after meeting a photographer who continues her activities while publicly identifying as a survivor of sexual violence. The camera turns toward survivors each living with different pain, capturing how they live alongside pain that cannot be put into words. Over the long production period, Kobayashi comes to question the meaning of making the film and begins to confront his own past. Kaori Oda, a visual artist known for works such as ARAGANE and Underground, handled cinematography. An official selection in the Nippon Cinema Now section of the 38th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2025.

synopsis: 1998年に日本中を騒然とさせた和歌山毒物カレー事件を多角的に検証したドキュメンタリー。 1998年7月、夏祭りで提供されたカレーに猛毒のヒ素が混入し、67人がヒ素中毒を発症、小学生を含む4人が死亡する事件が起こった。犯人と目されたのは近所に住む林眞須美で、凄惨な事件にマスコミ取材は過熱を極めた。彼女は容疑を否認しており、2009年に最高裁で死刑が確定した後も獄中から無実を訴え続けている。 最高裁判決に異議を唱える本作では、当時の目撃証言や科学鑑定への反証を試み、保険金詐欺事件との関係を読み解いていく。さらに、眞須美の夫・健治が自ら働いた保険金詐欺の実態を語り、確定死刑囚の息子として生きてきた浩次（仮名）が、母の無実を信じるようになった胸の内を明かす。 監督は、「不登校がやってきた」シリーズなどテレビのドキュメンタリー番組を中心に手がけてきた二村真弘。
tmdb_overview_en: A re-examination of the case of Masumi Hayashi, sentenced to death for arsenic poisoning of 63 victims at a summer festival in 1998.
synopsis_en: A documentary that examines from multiple angles the Wakayama poison curry incident that shook all of Japan in 1998. In July 1998, arsenic was mixed into curry served at a summer festival, causing 67 people to suffer arsenic poisoning and four people, including an elementary school child, to die. The person suspected as the culprit was Masumi Hayashi, who lived nearby, and media coverage of the horrific incident reached fever pitch. She has denied the charges, and even after her death sentence was finalized by the Supreme Court in 2009, she continues to proclaim her innocence from prison. Challenging the Supreme Court ruling, this film attempts to rebut the eyewitness testimony and scientific evidence from the time, and deciphers the connection to an insurance fraud case. Furthermore, Masumi's husband Kenji speaks about the reality of the insurance fraud he himself committed, and Koji (pseudonym), who has lived as the son of a condemned death row inmate, reveals his feelings about how he came to believe in his mother's innocence. The director is Masahiro Futamura, who has primarily worked on television documentary programs such as the "School Refusal Has Come" series.

synopsis: 「淵に立つ」「恋愛裁判」などの深田晃司監督が、松たか子を主演に迎えて撮りあげた人間ドラマ。第39回岸田國士戯曲賞を受賞した平田オリザの代表作「東京ノート」に着想を得て、深田監督自らオリジナル脚本を執筆。「東京ノート」の精神を受け継ぎつつ、岡山県奈義町をモデルにした「ナギ」を舞台に新たな物語を描き、企画の立ち上げから9年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 自然豊かな町・ナギで、ひとり創作に打ち込む彫刻家の寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍する友梨が数日間の休暇をとり、別れた夫の姉である寄子のもとを訪れる。若くして妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみ・好浩、息子の春樹とその親友・圭太など、人々との出会いは穏やかな日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。友梨は寄子の彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで彼女の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨自身にも変化が起こりはじめる。 深田監督とは初タッグとなる松たか子が、癒えない喪失を抱えながら彫刻制作に没頭する寄子という複雑なキャラクターを体現。寄子の彫刻のモデルをつとめる友梨を石橋静河、寄子の幼なじみで役場に勤める好浩を松山ケンイチが演じる。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.

synopsis: 台湾のCM界で活躍し、台湾人として初めてカンヌ国際広告賞の金獅子賞を受賞したワン・チャイシアン監督の長編デビュー作。戒厳令解除後の急速な経済成長と不安定な政治状況のなかで渦巻く焦燥と欲望を、実験的な映像表現と大胆な映像言語で鮮烈に描き出す。1997年・第47回ベルリン国際映画祭フォーラム部門に出品され台湾映画の新たな可能性を世界に示したが、台湾では公開からわずか数日で上映を打ち切られた。 台北に暮らすダンサーの青年はニューヨークに行くことを夢見ながら、夜はナイトクラブで働き、昼は恋人と過ごす日々を送っていた。祭りの夜、恋人の姿をビデオカメラで追っていた彼は、偶然にも殺人事件を撮影してしまい、謎の殺し屋から追われる身となる。混沌とした台北の街を疾走するなかで、現実と白昼夢の境界は次第にあいまいになり、ニューヨークからは疫病の知らせが届く。 主演は、1990年代に舞踏団「無垢舞蹈劇場」の主要ダンサーとしてヨーロッパや日本での海外公演にも参加したチェン・ホンレン。2026年10月、デジタルリマスター版にて劇場公開。
synopsis_en: The feature debut of director Wang Chia-hsiang, who was active in Taiwan's commercial scene and became the first Taiwanese to win the Golden Lion at the Cannes International Advertising Awards. Set amid rapid economic growth and unstable political conditions following the lifting of martial law, the film vividly depicts swirling impatience and desire through experimental visual expression and bold cinematic language. It was submitted to the Forum section of the 47th Berlin International Film Festival in 1997, showing the world new possibilities for Taiwanese cinema, but its theatrical run in Taiwan was cut short after only a few days. A young dancer living in Taipei dreams of going to New York, works at a nightclub at night, and spends his days with his lover. On the night of a festival, while chasing his lover with a video camera, he accidentally films a murder and finds himself pursued by a mysterious hitman. As he races through the chaotic streets of Taipei, the boundary between reality and daydream gradually blurs, and news of a plague arrives from New York. The lead role is played by Chen Hung-jung, who participated in overseas performances in Europe and Japan as a principal dancer of the dance company "Mute Dance Theatre" in the 1990s. The digitally remastered version will be released in theaters in October 2026.

tmdb_overview_en: A war widow with a young boy manages a farm with her bossy mother-in-law. When a reporter comes to interview her, the two begin an affair. He turns out to be married and won't leave his wife. Her older brother tries to marry off his children and hang on to/ extend his farm through an advantageous marriage in the face of threatened land confiscation and the desire of his children to get comfortable urban jobs instead of the backbreaking work in the paddy fields under parental control.

tmdb_overview_jp: 新婚一週間目に夫が消えた! 生きているなら証言して! 連続殺人を包む謎の霧! 鍵を握る三人の女! ! 広告社に勤める憲一は、新婚7日目に金沢へ出張、そのまま消息を絶った。妻の禎子は金沢へ出掛け、単身捜査に乗り出すが、手がかりはつかめなかった。やがて憲一が広告社に勤める前に、巡査の風紀係だったことが判明し、事件はそれに絡んでいる模様。そして意外な事実が明るみになってくる。野村芳太郎監督が、北陸を舞台に人間の孤独と悲しさをスリリングに描いた傑作。
tmdb_overview_en: One week into newlywed Teiko Uhara's marriage, her husband, Kenichi, leaves on a short business trip and never returns. Teiko travels across Japan to search for him, and along the way discovers some surprising facts about her husband's past. With only a pair of old photographs among his belongings to go off of, Teiko tries to figure out what has happened to him.
synopsis_en: Her husband vanished one week after their wedding! If he's alive, speak up! A mysterious fog shrouds a series of murders! Three women hold the key!! Kenichi, who works at an advertising company, goes on a business trip to Kanazawa on the seventh day of his marriage and disappears without a trace. His wife Teiko travels to Kanazawa and launches her own investigation, but finds no clues. Eventually it comes to light that before working at the advertising company, Kenichi had been a police officer in the morals division, and the case appears to be connected to that. Then an unexpected fact comes to light. A masterpiece in which director Yoshitaro Nomura thrillingly depicts human loneliness and sorrow against a Hokuriku setting.

tmdb_overview_en: Taiji (Kawazu Yusuke), who works at Noble Cosmetics, wants to marry his girlfriend Tomie (Kuwano Miyuki), but is having a hard time saving up the money. On a night train, he casually takes a photo of a middle-aged man and a young woman sleeping close together in seats diagonally opposite each other. In reality, the man is Aizawa (Sano Shuji), the section chief at the government agency where Tomie works. Tomie tells Taiji that she is pregnant and wants them to get married soon, so Taiji sends Aizawa the same photo. This is to ask him to buy it...

tmdb_overview_jp: 痴漢捜査官のジュンは、レズの恋人・里恵を目の前で誘拐されてしまう。7年前に彼女が取り逃がした連続レイプ犯の仕業と睨んだ彼女は、単身捜査を開始した。犯人のヒロシは忌まわしい過去を里恵に話し始めた。色情狂の父・憲邦が若い女を監禁凌辱していた事実。そして彼がジュンに股間を撃たれたことで幸福なはずの家庭が崩壊していったこと。ヒロシはその復讐を企んだのだった…。

synopsis_en: Jun, a groping-crime investigator, has her lesbian lover Rie kidnapped right before her eyes. Convinced it is the work of a serial rapist she failed to catch seven years ago, she begins an investigation on her own. The perpetrator, Hiroshi, begins telling Rie about his abhorrent past—the fact that his nymphomaniac father Norikuni had confined and violated young women, and that his supposedly happy family fell apart after Jun shot him in the groin. Hiroshi had been plotting his revenge...

country: 日本
synopsis: 「サマータイムマシン・ブルース」「リバー、流れないでよ」など数々の話題作で映画脚本を手がけてきた劇団「ヨーロッパ企画」代表の上田誠が長編初監督を務め、下北沢にある実在のビル「シェルボ下北沢」を舞台に斬新なギミックで描いた青春コメディ。 「シェルボ下北沢」の2階にある映画館・トリウッド。下北沢の劇作家・マドカと三軒茶屋のバンドマン・カズマはそれぞれ映画を見に行くが、互いの出来事が映画としてスクリーンに映し出されるという、ありえない構造が生まれてしまう。そんな中、映画館の両隣の店「グッドヘブンズ」と「三日月ロック」で問題が発生。マドカとカズマはこの構造を利用しながら問題の解決に挑むが、互いの映画は影響し合い、事態は予想外の方向へと展開していく。 劇作家のマドカ役で「サマーフィルムにのって」の伊藤万理華、バンドマンのカズマ役で「ミュジコフィリア」の井之脇海がそれぞれ主演を務め、マドカが主宰する劇団の団員役で前田旺志郎と菊池日菜子、カズマのバンドのメンバー役で金子鈴幸と三河悠冴、「三日月ロック」に出入りする半グレ役で今井隆文、刑事コンビ役でお笑いコンビ「ザ・ギース」が共演。さらに、石田剛太、金丸慎太郎、藤谷理子らヨーロッパ企画のメンバーが個性的なキャラクターたちを演じる。
tmdb_overview_en: The directorial debut of Makoto Ueda, the award-winning writer of such films as Beyond the Infinite Two Minutes, River, Night is Short Walk on Girl, etc
synopsis_en: A youth comedy directed by Makoto Ueda, head of the theater group "Europe Kikaku," known for writing screenplays for numerous hit films like "Summer Time Machine Blues" and "River, Don't Flow On." This is his feature directorial debut, set in the real-life building "Shelbo Shimokitazawa" in Shimokitazawa, employing innovative gimmicks. At the cinema Tollywood on the second floor of "Shelbo Shimokitazawa," Madoka, a playwright from Shimokitazawa, and Kazuma, a band musician from Sangenjaya, each go to see a movie. An impossible structure emerges where each other's events are projected onto the screen as a film. Meanwhile, problems arise at the shops adjacent to the cinema, "Good Heavens" and "Mikazuki Rock." Madoka and Kazuma try to solve the problems using this structure, but their films influence each other, and the situation spirals in unexpected directions. Starring Maria Ito ("Summer Film ni Notte") as Madoka the playwright and Kai Inowaki ("Musicophilia") as Kazuma the band musician. The cast also includes Oshiro Maeda and Hinako Kikuchi as members of Madoka's theater troupe, Suzuyuki Kaneko and Yusuke Mikawa as members of Kazuma's band, Takafumi Imai as a semi-delinquent who frequents "Mikazuki Rock," and the comedy duo "The Geese" as a pair of detectives. Additionally, members of Europe Kikaku, including Gota Ishida, Shintaro Kanamaru, and Riko Fujitani, play unique characters.

country: 日本
synopsis: 「MONDAYS このタイムループ、上司に気づかせないと終わらない」で注目を集めた竹林亮監督が、透明人間の娘と一緒に東京へ旅に出た家族の奮闘を描いたSFドラマ。 とある島でひっそりと暮らす星野家の父と3人の娘たちには、少し変わった秘密があった。それは、末娘のひかりが、生まれつき透明人間であること。娘たちを朗らかに育てた母が他界した後、心配性の父・学は三姉妹を人目から隠すようにして暮らしてきた。そんなある日、東京に住む大女優の祖母・砂川エリ子が入院したという知らせが届く。家族はひかりが透明人間であることをエリ子に打ち明けられないまま東京へ向かって出発するが、その道中にはさまざまな危険や困難が待ち受けていた。 「初級演技レッスン」「ケンとカズ」などの毎熊克哉が父・学役で主演を務め、近藤華が長女・風子役、矢山花が次女・音々役、鈴木凛子が透明人間の三女・ひかり役、余貴美子が祖母・砂川エリ子役、寺島進がタクシー運転手・倉田誠一役で共演。アニメーション映画「超かぐや姫！」の脚本家・夏生さえりが竹林監督と共同で企画・脚本を手がけた。
tmdb_overview_jp: とある島でひっそりと暮らす星野家の父と3人の娘たちには、少し変わった秘密があった。それは、末娘のひかりが、生まれつき透明人間であること。娘たちを朗らかに育てた母が他界した後、心配性の父・学は三姉妹を人目から隠すようにして暮らしてきた。そんなある日、東京に住む大女優の祖母・砂川エリ子が入院したという知らせが届く。家族はひかりが透明人間であることをエリ子に打ち明けられないまま東京へ向かって出発するが、その道中にはさまざまな危険や困難が待ち受けていた。
tmdb_overview_en: The story follows a family of five, living quietly and away from prying eyes on the Izu Islands—including the youngest daughter, born invisible. Their mother, who had raised her cheerfully, has passed away from illness, and their anxious father has devoted himself to hiding his daughters from the world. One day, however, they must set out on a journey to visit their grandmother, a famous actress living in Tokyo.
synopsis_en: An SF drama directed by Ryo Takebayashi (who gained attention for "MONDAYS: See You 'This' Week!"), depicting the struggles of a family who travels to Tokyo with their invisible daughter. The father and three daughters of the Hoshino family, living quietly on a certain island, share a slightly unusual secret: their youngest daughter, Hikari, is born invisible. After the mother, who raised the daughters cheerfully, passed away, the worrisome father, Manabu, has lived keeping the three sisters hidden from prying eyes. One day, news arrives that their grandmother, the great actress Eriko Sunagawa, who lives in Tokyo, has been hospitalized. The family heads to Tokyo without being able to tell Eriko that Hikari is invisible, but various dangers and difficulties await them along the way. Katsuya Maiguma (from "Shokyu Enshu Lesson" and "Ken to Kazu") stars as the father Manabu, with Hana Kondo as the eldest daughter Fuko, Hana Yayama as the second daughter Nene, Rinko Suzuki as the invisible third daughter Hikari, Kimiko Yo as grandmother Eriko Sunagawa, and Susumu Terajima as taxi driver Seiichi Kurata. Saeri Natsuo, screenwriter of the animated film "Super Kaguyahime," co-planned and co-wrote the script with director Takebayashi.

country: 日本
synopsis: 映画監督・映像ディレクター・プロデューサー・作家・ミュージシャン・デザイナーなど多彩なメンバーが在籍するクリエイターユニット「P-kraft」が制作したオムニバス映画。P-kraftに所属する作家・関口純の書き下ろし短編3本を原作に、さまざまなコミュニティが小さな嘘や見栄によって思いがけない方向へと展開していく様子を、3人の監督がそれぞれ異なるアプローチで描き出す。 社会学のフィールドワークで平凡な田舎町に移住した真面目すぎる大学院生と、彼をからかおうと悪ふざけをヒートアップさせていく町民たちを描く「社会学者の調査」、好意を寄せる同僚が映画好きだと知った無趣味な会社員が、無名の映画監督の上映会で映画通のフリをしたことから思わぬ困難に陥っていく「消えた日曜日」、思い入れのある市立図書館の閉鎖を告げられた市役所職員が、図書館を救うためにでっちあげた流行語で想定外の大ブームを巻き起こしてしまう「神様は、どこ？」の3作品で構成。 監督を担うのは、P-kraft代表を務める映像ディレクターの板部文、映画美術デザイナーの安藤秀敏、映像学校講師も務める映画監督の笹木惠水。
synopsis_en: An omnibus film produced by the creator unit "P-kraft," whose members include film directors, visual directors, producers, writers, musicians, and designers. Based on three newly written short stories by P-kraft member and author Jun Sekiguchi, three directors each depict, through different approaches, how various communities are pushed in unexpected directions by small lies and vanity. The film comprises "The Sociologist's Investigation," about an overly serious graduate student who moves to an ordinary rural town for sociological fieldwork and the townspeople whose pranks escalate as they try to tease him; "The Vanished Sunday," about a company employee with no hobbies who, upon learning that a colleague he has feelings for loves movies, pretends to be a film buff at a screening by an unknown director and lands himself in unexpected trouble; and "Where Is God?," about a city hall employee who, told that a municipal library he cares deeply about will be closed, invents a catchphrase to save it and inadvertently sets off an unforeseen massive boom. The directors are Fumi Itabe, a visual director who serves as P-kraft's representative; Hidetoshi Ando, a film art designer; and Keisui Sasaki, a film director who also teaches at a film school.

synopsis: 1970年代ローマの衣装工房を舞台に繰り広げられるお針子の女性たちの人生模様をユーモラスに描き、本国イタリアで話題を集めたヒューマンドラマ。「カプチーノはお熱いうちに」「あしたのパスタはアルデンテ」のフェルザン・オズペテク監督が、自身が助監督時代にローマの老舗衣装工房で出会った人々との思い出を原点に、イタリア映画黄金時代を支えた職人たちへのオマージュを込めて描き出す。 1970年代、ローマ。カノーヴァ姉妹が経営する衣装工房では、お針子たちが忙しく立ち働いている。シングルマザーの帽子担当パオリーナ、夫の暴力に怯えるお針子ニコレッタなど、華やかな衣装制作の裏側で、彼女たちはそれぞれ事情を抱えていた。ある日、世界的な衣装デザイナーから新作の依頼が舞い込む。その高い要求に応えるべく、見たこともないような至高の一着を作ろうと奮闘する彼女たちだったが……。 出演は「パルテノペ　ナポリの宝石」のルイーザ・ラニエリ、「息子の部屋」のジャスミン・トリンカ、「はじまりは5つ星ホテルから」のステファノ・アコルシ。2026年ミラノ・コルティナ冬季オリンピック閉会式の衣装を手がけたステファノ・チャミッティが衣装デザインを担当。2025年・第70回ダヴィッド・ディ・ドナテッロ賞で観客賞を受賞した。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1970s Rome, a filmmaker gathers actresses for a new project, which triggers memories of his past working in a Roman costume shop, run by Alberta and Gabriella, navigating personal and professional challenges while creating costumes for a major film.
director_jp: フェルザン・オズペテク
synopsis_en: A humorous human drama set in a 1970s Rome costume workshop, depicting the lives of the seamstresses, which became a hot topic in Italy. Directed by Ferzan Özpetek ("Bitter Coffee," "Tomorrow's Pasta is Al Dente"), the film is inspired by his memories of the people he met at a historic Roman costume workshop during his time as an assistant director, paying homage to the artisans who supported the golden age of Italian cinema. In 1970s Rome, at the costume workshop run by the Canova sisters, the seamstresses work busily. Behind the scenes of glamorous costume creation, each woman has her own troubles: Paolina, a single mother in charge of hats, and Nicoletta, a seamstress afraid of her violent husband. One day, a request for a new creation comes from a world-renowned costume designer. To meet their high demands, they strive to create a supreme, one-of-a-kind garment unlike anything seen before... Starring Luisa Ranieri ("Parthenope"), Jasmine Trinca ("The Son's Room"), and Stefano Accorsi ("The Starting Line"). Costumes are designed by Stefano Ciamitti, who also designed the costumes for the closing ceremony of the 2026 Milan-Cortina Winter Olympics. The film won the Audience Award at the 70th David di Donatello Awards in 2025.

synopsis: 安田章大（SUPER EIGHT）とのんが主演を務め、自閉スペクトラム症の兄と結婚を控える妹の温かくも強い絆を描いたヒューマンドラマ。 自閉スペクトラム症の大貴と、幼い頃から彼を支えてきた妹の希。母を早くに亡くした彼らはネグレクト気味の父から距離を置き、ふたりで懸命に生きてきた。現在、大貴は清掃の仕事に就き、周囲のサポートを受けながら自立した生活を送っている。大貴はほとんど会話をせず、表情もあまり変わらないように見える。独自の規則を持つ彼は、すべてを平行と垂直に並べるほど几帳面でこだわりが強く、机に並ぶ食器もていねいにそろえる。週に1度の希との食事の時間は19時ちょうどで、1分でも過ぎると落ち着かなくなる。カウンセラーとして働いている希は、ある日恋人からプロポーズを受け、一抹の不安を抱えながら大貴とともに恋人の両親に会いに大阪から東京へ向かう。希の結婚話をきっかけに、兄妹は思いがけずお互いの過去と未来に向き合うことになる。 劇団ふくふくや主宰で俳優としても活躍する山野海によるオリジナル脚本に感銘を受けた安田章大が製作を熱望し、企画から参加。自閉スペクトラム症の専門家の監修のもと約2年かけて脚本を練り、安田自身も専門家のレクチャーを受けて撮影に臨んだ。監督は「かぞくのひけつ」「毎日かあさん」の小林聖太郎。
tmdb_overview_jp: 自閉症の大貴と定型発達の希、そんな兄妹の微々たる成長物語であその2人と関わる人々が心に棲まわせる寛大、辛辣、はたまた無関心というあらゆる本音たちと共に生きていく物語です。
tmdb_overview_en: Daiki has autism spectrum disorder, and his sister Nozomi has supported him since childhood. Having lost their mother at a young age, the siblings distanced themselves from their neglectful father and have lived their lives diligently together
synopsis_en: Yasuda Shota (SUPER EIGHT) and Non star in this human drama depicting the warm yet strong bond between a brother with autism spectrum disorder and his sister who is about to get married. Taiki, who has autism spectrum disorder, and his sister Nozomi, who has supported him since childhood. Having lost their mother early, they kept their distance from their neglectful father and lived desperately on their own. Now, Taiki works a cleaning job and lives independently with support from those around him. Taiki rarely speaks and his expressions seem to barely change. He has his own rules and is so meticulous and particular that he arranges everything in parallel and perpendicular lines, carefully lining up the dishes on the table. His weekly meal with Nozomi is exactly at 7:00 PM, and he becomes restless if it's even a minute past. Nozomi, who works as a counselor, one day receives a proposal from her boyfriend, and with a hint of unease, heads to Tokyo with Taiki to meet her boyfriend's parents. Triggered by Nozomi's marriage talk, the siblings unexpectedly come face to face with each other's past and future. Yasuda Shota, deeply impressed by the original screenplay by Yamano Umi—who leads the theater company Fuku Fukuya and is also active as an actress—fervently wished to produce it and participated from the planning stage. The script was developed over about two years under the supervision of an autism spectrum disorder specialist, and Yasuda himself received lectures from the specialist before filming. Directed by Kobayashi Seitaro of "Kazoku no Hiketsu" and "Mainichi Kaasan."

synopsis: 落語家・快楽亭ブラックの生き様を描いたドキュメンタリー。 落語界のカリスマ・立川談志の弟子であり、彼が残した名言「落語とは、人間の業の肯定である」を体現するかのような破滅的な生活と過激な落語で知られる快楽亭ブラック。メディアへの露出は限定的でありながら、長年にわたり根強い人気を集めてきた。コンプライアンスが厳しい現代、もはや二度と現れないかもしれない芸人らしい芸人であり、すべての出来事を笑い飛ばすその了見は、息苦しい現代を生きる術でもある。1952年に米軍兵士と日本人女性との間に生まれたブラックは、差別から逃れるため、幼少期から多くの時間を映画館の闇の中で過ごした。69年に立川談志に入門するが、師匠のお金を競馬に使ったことが発覚して破門される。79年に談志門下に戻り、92年に二代目・快楽亭ブラックを襲名し真打昇進するも、2005年に借金2000万円が発覚して落語立川流を自主退会。その後も過激な落語で人気を集める一方、歌舞伎や日本映画への造詣から、評論家・脚本家としても活動している。 映画祭の主宰や映画館の運営を経て映画制作を行う榎園喬介が監督を務めた。活動弁士の坂本頼光が語りを担当。
synopsis_en:
A documentary depicting the life of Rakugo performer Kairakutei Black. A disciple of the legendary Danshi Tatekawa, Black is known for a self-destructive lifestyle and radical Rakugo style that seems to embody his master’s famous words: "Rakugo is the affirmation of human karma." Despite limited media exposure, he has maintained a loyal following for many years. In an era of strict compliance, he is a "true entertainer" the likes of whom may never appear again; his philosophy of laughing off every misfortune offers a way to navigate today’s suffocating world. 

Born in 1952 to a U.S. soldier and a Japanese woman, Black spent much of his childhood in the darkness of movie theaters to escape discrimination. He became an apprentice to Danshi Tatekawa in 1969 but was expelled after it was discovered he had used his master’s money for horse racing. He returned to the fold in 1979, took the name Kairakutei Black II, and was promoted to *shin'uchi* (master rank) in 1992. However, in 2005, he voluntarily left the Tatekawa school after a debt of 20 million yen came to light. While continuing to draw crowds with his provocative Rakugo, his deep knowledge of Kabuki and Japanese cinema has also led to a career as a critic and screenwriter. The film is directed by Kyosuke Enokizono, who moved into filmmaking after organizing film festivals and managing movie theaters. Narration is provided by *katsudo benshi* (silent film narrator) Raiko Sakamoto.

synopsis: 「ヤンヤン　夏の想い出」などで知られ、1980～90年代には台湾ニューシネマを牽引した鬼才エドワード・ヤン監督が1986年に手がけた長編第3作。80年代の台北を舞台に、都会に暮らす人々の不条理や孤独を浮き彫りにした群像劇。 80年代半ばの台北。街で起きた銃撃事件を偶然撮影した若い写真家は、その現場から逃げ出した少女の姿をカメラに収める。一方、医師の夫と暮らす女性作家は、新作の執筆に行き詰まり、夫との間にもかすかな亀裂を抱えていた。 出版社に勤める元恋人、事件を追う刑事、街を漂う若者たち。一見すると無関係な人々の人生が、あるいたずら電話をきっかけに、思いもよらぬかたちで少しずつ結びついていき、やがて悲劇が巻き起こる。日本では1996年に劇場初公開。2015年にデジタルリマスター版でリバイバル公開。2026年には、エドワード・ヤン監督デビュー作「海辺の一日」が劇場初公開されるのにあわせて、本作もリバイバル公開される。
tmdb_overview_jp: 台北を舞台に、カメラマンとその恋人、小説家の妻と医師の夫、その元恋人、不良少女、刑事…様々な人物が幾重にも錯綜し現代の台湾が抱える問題を浮き彫りにしていく。

synopsis: 埼玉県さいたま市の沼影市民プールが営業を終えるまでの49日間を記録したドキュメンタリー。 「海なき市にプールを」という市民の願いから1971年に誕生した沼影市民プールは、人々の憩いと出会い、そして健康を支える場として、52年間で約600万人が訪れた。しかし2021年、さいたま市はプールの解体と、小中一貫校の建設を発表する。存続を求めて900通を超えるパブリックコメントや1万人以上からの署名が寄せられたものの計画は進み、2024年3月、沼影市民プールは静かにその役目を終えた。 「わたしたちに許された特別な時間の終わり」「解放区」などの太田信吾監督が、沼影市民プールが営業終了の日を迎えるまでの49日間にカメラを向け、公共施設の喪失が市民に何をもたらすのかを見つめていく。制作段階において、チェコのカルロヴィ・ヴァリ国際映画祭2024にて日本企画として初となる「First Cut+ Works in Progress Award」を受賞。完成後も第30回釜山国際映画祭ワイドアングル部門、第27回テッサロニキ国際ドキュメンタリー映画祭などに出品された。
synopsis_en: A documentary recording the final 49 days of Numakage Civic Pool in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture, until it closed its doors for good. Born in 1971 from citizens' wishes for "a pool in a city without a sea," Numakage Civic Pool served as a place of rest, encounter, and health for the community, visited by approximately 6 million people over 52 years. However, in 2021, Saitama City announced the pool's demolition and the construction of an integrated elementary and junior high school. Despite over 900 public comments and petitions signed by more than 10,000 people calling for its preservation, the plan proceeded, and in March 2024, Numakage Civic Pool quietly ended its role. Director Shingo Ota, known for works like "The End of the Special Time We Were Allowed" and "Liberated Zone," turns his camera on the 49 days leading up to the pool's final day of operation, examining what the loss of a public facility brings to citizens. During the production phase, it became the first Japanese project to receive the "First Cut+ Works in Progress Award" at the Karlovy Vary International Film Festival 2024 in the Czech Republic. After completion, it was also screened at the 30th Busan International Film Festival's Wide Angle section and the 27th Thessaloniki International Documentary Festival.

synopsis: 「女っ気なし」「やさしい人」などのギョーム・ブラック監督が、南フランスの風光明媚な景色の中で夏のバカンスを謳歌する若者たちの姿を優しいまなざしでつづった青春映画。 夏の夜のセーヌ川のほとり。不器用な青年フェリックスはアルマに恋をし、夢のような時間を過ごす。しかし翌朝、アルマは家族とバカンスへ旅立ってしまう。フェリックスは優しい親友シェリフや相乗りアプリで知り合った生真面目な青年エドゥアールとともに、アルマを追って南フランスの田舎町ディーを目指すが……。 2017年製作の「7月の物語」に続いてブラック監督がフランス国立高等演劇学校の学生たちと制作した作品で、俳優には長編映画初出演の学生たちを起用。2020年・第70回ベルリン国際映画祭パノラマ部門で国際映画批評家連盟賞特別賞を受賞した。
tmdb_overview_en: An unlikely oddball trio bond during an impromptu trip to the French countryside on a foolhardy romantic mission.
synopsis_en: A youth film directed by Guillaume Brac, known for 'A Summer's Tale' and 'The Gentle Ones,' which tenderly follows young people enjoying their summer vacation amidst the scenic beauty of Southern France. On a summer night by the Seine, the awkward young man Félix falls in love with Alma and spends a dreamlike time with her. However, the next morning, Alma leaves for vacation with her family. Félix, along with his kind best friend Sheriff and the earnest young man Édouard he met through a ride-sharing app, sets off to chase after Alma to the small rural town of Die in Southern France... Following his 2017 film 'July Tales,' Brac made this work with students from the National Academy of Dramatic Arts in France, casting students appearing in their first feature film. It won the Special Prize of the International Federation of Film Critics in the Panorama section of the 70th Berlin International Film Festival in 2020.

synopsis: 1990年代の台湾を舞台に、マーチングバンド部の活動に青春をかける男子高校生たちの姿を、実話をもとに描いた青春ドラマ。 1990年代の台北。台湾屈指の進学校である建国高校に通うジャン・ハオは、ひとり息子の医学部進学を望む父親の期待を背負い、プレッシャーを抱えながら高校生活を送っていた。そんなある日、彼はマーチングバンド部の活動に興味を持ち、父親に内緒で入部する。天才肌だが自由気ままな問題児のリウ・ジーチュワンや、責任感の強い優等生の部長タイチェンらと共に、部活動に励むジャン・ハオだったが……。 監督は、映画「角頭　彷徨人」やテレビドラマ「We Best Love 永遠の1位／2位の反撃」などで知られるジャン・ルイジー。若手俳優ムー・センが主人公ジャン・ハオを好演し、台湾のアカデミー賞といわれる台湾金馬奨で新人俳優賞にノミネートされた。共演に「セデック・バレ」のマー・ジーシアン。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1992, five years after Taiwan lifted martial law, Jiang, a high school student destined for a top medical college, secretly joins the school’s marching band to chase his passion for music. When the band faces closure due to its outdated focus on martial music, Jiang and his fellow members rally together, determined to save it and reclaim its honor in a prestigious competition.

synopsis_en: A coming-of-age drama based on a true story, set in 1990s Taiwan, depicting high school boys who devote their youth to the activities of a marching band club. In 1990s Taipei. Jiang Hao, who attends Jianguo High School, one of Taiwan's most prestigious schools, lives his high school life under pressure, carrying the expectations of his father who wants his only son to enter medical school. One day, he takes an interest in the marching band club's activities and joins without telling his father. Alongside the naturally gifted but free-spirited troublemaker Liu Zhi-Chuan and the highly responsible honor student and club president Tai-Chen, Jiang Hao throws himself into club activities, but... The director is Jiang Rui-Zhi, known for the film "Gatao: Like Father Like Son" and the TV drama "We Best Love: No. 1 For You / Fighting Mr. 2nd." Young actor Moon Sen gives a fine performance as protagonist Jiang Hao and was nominated for Best New Performer at the Golden Horse Awards, Taiwan's equivalent of the Academy Awards. Ma Zhi-Xiang of "Seediq Bale" co-stars.

synopsis: 森田剛が主演を務め、マンガの制作現場を舞台に万年アシスタントの中年男性の奮闘を軽やかにつづったヒューマンドラマ。 巨匠マンガ家のアシスタントを長年にわたり務めてきた、42歳の土屋輝一。マンガ家デビューした後輩や人気声優である別居中の妻に対してモヤモヤした思いを抱え、一緒に暮らす高校受験生の娘とも気持ちがすれ違ってばかりいる。そんな彼のもとに、あるマンガ企画が舞い込む。仕事への熱量不足を自覚する29歳の中堅編集者・潮田ユキと、マンガ家を志す猪突猛進な40歳の新人アシスタント・山田ぽてとと共に、マンガ制作に踏み出す土屋だったが……。 編集者・潮田ユキ役で森川葵、新人アシスタント・山田ぽてと役で川上友里、潮田の上司である編集部長・馬場明役で阿部寛、土屋の別居中の妻・莉花役で松本まりか、土屋がアシスタントを務める巨匠マンガ家・吉住はるを役で武田鉄矢、土屋の娘・ひかり役で早瀬憩が共演。監督は、是枝裕和監督作の助監督などを務めてきた森本晶一と、「泣く子はいねぇが」の佐藤快磨。是枝監督率いる映像制作者集団「分福」に所属する両監督が共同監督を務め、森本監督が自身の経験に着想を得て原案・オリジナル脚本を手がけた。
tmdb_overview_en: Teruichi Tsuchiya, 42, is a perpetual assistant to a master manga artist. He feels uneasy about his junior colleague who has debuted as a manga artist, his estranged wife who is a popular voice actress, and for some reason, he is constantly at odds with his daughter, who lives with him and is preparing for her high school entrance exams. Just as a 17-year-old manga series comes to an end, a new manga project comes along. Joining him are Yuki Shioda, a 29-year-old editor who is aware of his lack of passion for his work, and Potato Yamada, a headstrong 40-year-old rookie assistant. What future awaits him after taking this step…?
synopsis_en: A human drama starring Go Morita that lightly depicts the struggles of a middle-aged man who has been a perpetual assistant in the manga production industry. Koichi Tsuchiya, 42, has spent years as an assistant to a master manga artist. He harbors complicated feelings toward a junior colleague who made his manga debut before him and toward his estranged wife, a popular voice actress, and his feelings constantly miss the mark with his high school exam-taking daughter who lives with him. Then a certain manga project lands in his lap. Alongside Yuki Shioda, a 29-year-old mid-level editor aware of her own lack of passion for the work, and Yamada Potato, a headstrong 40-year-old new assistant who dreams of becoming a manga artist, Tsuchiya sets out on manga production—but... Aoi Morikawa plays editor Yuki Shioda, Yuri Kawakami plays new assistant Yamada Potato, Hiroshi Abe plays Shioda's boss and editorial department head Akira Baba, Marika Matsumoto plays Tsuchiya's estranged wife Rika, Tetsuya Takeda plays the master manga artist Haruo Yoshizumi whom Tsuchiya assists, and Ikoi Hayase plays Tsuchiya's daughter Hikari. The directors are Shoichi Morimoto, who has served as assistant director on Hirokazu Kore-eda's films, and Kaishu Sato of "The Kids Are Fine." Both directors belong to the filmmaking collective "Bunbuku" led by Kore-eda, and serve as co-directors; Morimoto conceived the original story and wrote the original screenplay inspired by his own experiences.

synopsis: 1990年代の台湾を舞台に、マーチングバンド部の活動に青春をかける男子高校生たちの姿を、実話をもとに描いた青春ドラマ。 1990年代の台北。台湾屈指の進学校である建国高校に通うジャン・ハオは、ひとり息子の医学部進学を望む父親の期待を背負い、プレッシャーを抱えながら高校生活を送っていた。そんなある日、彼はマーチングバンド部の活動に興味を持ち、父親に内緒で入部する。天才肌だが自由気ままな問題児のリウ・ジーチュワンや、責任感の強い優等生の部長タイチェンらと共に、部活動に励むジャン・ハオだったが……。 監督は、映画「角頭　彷徨人」やテレビドラマ「We Best Love 永遠の1位／2位の反撃」などで知られるジャン・ルイジー。若手俳優ムー・センが主人公ジャン・ハオを好演し、台湾のアカデミー賞といわれる台湾金馬奨で新人俳優賞にノミネートされた。共演に「セデック・バレ」のマー・ジーシアン。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1992, five years after Taiwan lifted martial law, Jiang, a high school student destined for a top medical college, secretly joins the school’s marching band to chase his passion for music. When the band faces closure due to its outdated focus on martial music, Jiang and his fellow members rally together, determined to save it and reclaim its honor in a prestigious competition.
clean_title_jp: 進行曲 マーチングボーイズ
synopsis_en: A coming-of-age drama based on a true story, set in 1990s Taiwan, depicting high school boys who devote their youth to the activities of a marching band club. In 1990s Taipei. Jiang Hao, who attends Jianguo High School, one of Taiwan's most prestigious schools, lives his high school life under pressure, carrying the expectations of his father who wants his only son to enter medical school. One day, he takes an interest in the marching band club's activities and joins without telling his father. Alongside the naturally gifted but free-spirited troublemaker Liu Zhi-Chuan and the highly responsible honor student and club president Tai-Chen, Jiang Hao throws himself into club activities, but... The director is Jiang Rui-Zhi, known for the film "Gatao: Like Father Like Son" and the TV drama "We Best Love: No. 1 For You / Fighting Mr. 2nd." Young actor Moon Sen gives a fine performance as protagonist Jiang Hao and was nominated for Best New Performer at the Golden Horse Awards, Taiwan's equivalent of the Academy Awards. Ma Zhi-Xiang of "Seediq Bale" co-stars.

movie_title: 踊る大捜査線 N.E.W. メトロポリスを駆け抜けろ！
movie_title_jp: 踊る大捜査線 N.E.W. メトロポリスを駆け抜けろ！
movie_title_original: 踊る大捜査線 N.E.W. メトロポリスを駆け抜けろ！
country: 日本
synopsis: 織田裕二が湾岸署の刑事・青島俊作を演じ、社会現象を巻き起こした人気シリーズ「踊る大捜査線」の劇場版。青島俊作を主人公とする物語としては約14年ぶりの新作となり、主演の織田裕二をはじめ、監督の本広克行、脚本の君塚良一、プロデューサーの亀山千広らオリジナルのキャスト＆スタッフが再結集。タイトルの「N.E.W.」は「NEXT. EVOLUTION. WORLD.」の略で、本作から青島俊作の新たな物語が始動する。 世界屈指の巨大都市（メトロポリス）・東京。ある日、通称「225事案」と呼ばれる誘拐事件が発生する。犯人は身代金の運び屋として、警視庁刑事部捜査第一課に着任した青島を指名。要求に間に合わなければ街を爆破すると告げる。さらに、3Dプリンター拳銃による連続殺人や、盗まれた毒性ウイルスを街にばらまくという脅迫も発生。一方、捜査の優先順位をAIが判断し、逮捕状の請求すらAIにゆだねる警察組織の変貌も明らかになるが、青島は変わらぬ信念を胸に東京を駆け抜ける。 キャストには趣里、白洲迅、増田貴久ら新たな顔ぶれが参加するほか、ユースケ・サンタマリア、真矢ミキ、水野美紀、甲本雅裕、寺島進、伊藤淳史、斉藤暁、小野武彦、北村総一朗ら歴代のメンバーも顔をそろえる。音楽も、これまでのシリーズを手がけてきた松本晃彦が担当し、主題歌には織田裕二によるシリーズおなじみの「Love Somebody」が起用された。
tmdb_overview_jp: ある日、東京都内で誘拐事件が発生。 犯人は身代金を指定の場所まで持ってくるよう指示をし、 間に合わなければ街を爆破するという。 そして、なぜかその“運び屋”として青島を指名する。 さらに、3Dプリンター拳銃を使用した連続殺人事件も発生。 殺された被害者の一人である科学者が持っていた毒性ウイルスも盗まれており、 警視庁には「ウイルスを街にばらまく」という脅迫文が届く。 警視庁の捜査一課に着任した青島に、史上最悪クラスの難事件が次々に押し寄せる。 “犯人”はいったい―？ 事件解決のため、青島は仲間とともに東京の街を走りに走りまくる！！
clean_title_jp: 踊る大捜査線 N.E.W. メトロポリスを駆け抜けろ！
synopsis_en: A theatrical installment of the hit series Odoru Daisosasen (Bayside Shakedown), which caused a social phenomenon, with Yuji Oda playing Shunsaku Aoshima of the Wangan Police Station. It is the first new work in approximately 14 years to feature Shunsaku Aoshima as the protagonist, reuniting the original cast and staff including star Yuji Oda, director Katsuyuki Motohiro, screenwriter Ryoichi Kimizuka, and producer Chihiro Kameyama. The N.E.W. in the title stands for NEXT. EVOLUTION. WORLD., and a new story for Shunsaku Aoshima begins with this film. Tokyo, one of the world's greatest metropolises. One day, a kidnapping case known as the 225 Incident occurs. The perpetrator names Aoshima, newly assigned to the First Investigation Division of the Metropolitan Police Department's Criminal Investigation Bureau, as the ransom courier. If the demands are not met in time, the city will be blown up. Furthermore, threats emerge involving a series of murders committed with 3D-printed guns and the release of a stolen toxic virus into the city. Meanwhile, the police organization itself is transforming, with AI determining investigation priorities and even handling warrant requests, but Aoshima races through Tokyo with his unchanging convictions. New faces joining the cast include Shuri, Shirasu Jin, and Takahisa Masuda, while veterans such as Yusuke Santamaria, Miki Maya, Miki Mizuno, Masahiro Komoto, Susumu Terajima, Atsushi Ito, Satoru Saito, Takehiko Ono, and Soichiro Kitamura also return. Music is handled by Akihiko Matsumoto, who has scored the previous series, and the theme song is Love Somebody, the series staple performed by Yuji Oda.

movie_title_jp: 映画ちいかわ　人魚の島のひみつ
movie_title_en: Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of the Mermaid Island
movie_title_original: 映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ
country: 日本
synopsis: イラストレーターのナガノが2020年よりX（旧Twitter）にて原作漫画を連載し、「日本キャラクター大賞グランプリ」を3度受賞、22年に放送開始されたテレビアニメもYouTubeでの見逃し配信総再生回数が4億回を超えるなど、数々の社会現象を巻き起こしてきた大人気コンテンツ「ちいかわ」をアニメーション映画化。原作者・ナガノによる完全監修のもと、原作漫画シリーズの中でも特に人気の高い長編エピソード「セイレーン編」を映像化し、とある島を訪れたちいかわたちが繰り広げる大冒険を壮大な音楽と迫力の映像で描き出す。 ある日、広場でくつろいでいたちいかわとハチワレのもとに、顔にチラシを貼り付けたうさぎが現れる。ハチワレがチラシの内容を確認すると、それは「特別な島」への招待状だった。「島でのカンタンな討伐で100倍の報酬をもらおう」「限定島ラーメンに限定スイーツ、甘いもの辛いもの全部実質無料」といった言葉に釣られて島合宿に参加することを決めたちいかわたちは、チラシの内容を怪しがるラッコとともに船に乗り込み、島に上陸するが……。 「ウマ娘　プリティーダービー　新時代の扉」などのCygamesPicturesがアニメーション制作を担当。
tmdb_overview_jp: ある日、ちいかわとハチワレが広場でくつろいでいると、突如として顔にチラシを貼り付けたうさぎがやって来る。ハチワレがそのチラシを確認すると、それは「特別な島へご招待」と書かれた招待状であった。  「島でのカンタンな討伐で100倍の報酬をもらおう」「限定島ラーメンに限定スイーツ、甘いもの辛いもの全部実質無料」といった言葉に釣られ、島合宿に行くことを決めたちいかわたち。チラシの内容を怪しがるラッコとともに乗船し、島に上陸したちいかわ一同を待ち受けていたものとは…!?
tmdb_overview_en: Chiikawa and friends set off on a whimsical summer adventure to a mysterious island said to hide a long-lost mermaid secret. What starts as a fun getaway quickly turns into a heartwarming journey filled with surprises, gentle thrills, and adorable chaos. With sparkling seas, strange legends, and unforgettable encounters, the trio learns about courage, friendship, and the magic hidden in small moments.
clean_title_jp: 映画ちいかわ 人魚の島のひみつ
synopsis_en: Based on the original manga serialized on X (formerly Twitter) since 2020 by illustrator Nagano, the massively popular "Chiikawa" franchise—winner of the Japan Character Grand Prix three times, with its 2022 TV anime's catch-up streams on YouTube surpassing 400 million views—gets an animated film adaptation. Under the complete supervision of creator Nagano, the film adapts the particularly popular long-form "Siren Arc" from the original manga series, depicting a grand adventure of Chiikawa and friends on a mysterious island through epic music and powerful visuals. One day, while Chiikawa and Hachiware are relaxing in the square, a rabbit with a flyer stuck to its face appears. Hachiware reads the flyer, which turns out to be an invitation to a "special island." Tempted by promises of "easy monster subjugation on the island for 100x rewards" and "limited island ramen, limited sweets—sweet and spicy stuff all practically free," Chiikawa and friends decide to join the island camp. Along with a skeptical otter, they board a ship and land on the island, but... CygamesPictures, known for "Umamusume: Pretty Derby - Beginning of a New Era," handles the animation production.

synopsis: 第96回アカデミー賞でアジア映画として初の視覚効果賞を受賞するなど、世界的に大きな話題を集めた「ゴジラ－1.0」の続編。山崎貴が引き続き監督・脚本・VFXを担い、前作から2年後の世界を舞台に、再び姿を現したゴジラとの新たな戦いを描き出す。 戦争によって「無（ゼロ）」となった日本を、ゴジラが「負（マイナス）」に叩き落としてから2年。もがき苦しみながらも復興を遂げ、ようやく取り戻したはずの日常に、再びゴジラが襲いかかる。人々はこの戦いを終わらせるべく、総力を結集して新たな作戦に乗り出す。 キャストは、前作でゴジラと壮絶な死闘を繰り広げた主人公・敷島浩一役の神木隆之介、ゴジラに襲われながらも奇跡的に一命をとりとめたヒロイン・敷島典子役の浜辺美波をはじめ、山田裕貴、佐々木蔵之介、安藤サクラ、吉岡秀隆ら前作の顔ぶれが再集結。さらに新たなメンバーとして、気象台から大型災害対策事務局に出向した天才気象予報官・青山真琴役で長澤まさみ、戦争で心に深い傷を負った生物学者・村上寛治役で田中泯、医師・緒方役で國村隼が出演。
tmdb_overview_en: War reduced Japan to zero, and Godzilla plunged it into minus. Two years have passed since then, and the country has faced agonizing struggles to achieve recovery and finally reclaim its daily life. Just as humanity managed to cling to a hard-won peace, a new threat strikes, crushing hope in an instant. There is no third time. Everything ends here.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: The sequel to "Godzilla Minus One," which became a global phenomenon and made history as the first Asian film to win the Academy Award for Best Visual Effects at the 96th Academy Awards. Takashi Yamazaki returns as director, screenwriter, and VFX supervisor, depicting a new battle against Godzilla, who reappears two years after the events of the previous film. Two years after Godzilla reduced Japan—already brought to "zero" by war—to "minus," the nation has struggled and rebuilt, and just as people have finally reclaimed their everyday lives, Godzilla strikes again. To end this battle, the people unite all their strength for a new operation. The cast reunites familiar faces from the previous film, including Ryunosuke Kamiki as Koichi Shikishima, the protagonist who fought a desperate life-or-death struggle with Godzilla, and Minami Hamabe as Noriko Shikishima, the heroine who miraculously survived Godzilla's attack, alongside Yuki Yamada, Kuranosuke Sasaki, Sakura Ando, and Hidetaka Yoshioka. New additions include Masami Nagasawa as Makoto Aoyama, a genius meteorologist transferred from the meteorological observatory to the Large-Scale Disaster Countermeasures Bureau; Min Tanaka as Kanji Murakami, a biologist deeply scarred by the war; and Jun Kunimura as Dr. Ogata.
