director: デビッド・ボレンスタイン
country: デンマーク・チェコ合作 原題または英題：Mr. Nobody Against Putin
synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

cinema_address: 神奈川県逗子市新宿1-5-14
movie_title: ホールディング・リアット
tmdb_overview_en: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.
synopsis_en: A documentary depicting an Israeli-American family's desperate efforts to rescue their daughter abducted by Hamas, crossing divides. On the morning of October 7, 2023, the agricultural community of Nir Oz in southwestern Israel was attacked by Hamas militants, with a quarter of its roughly 400 residents killed or taken hostage. Yehuda, the father of hostage Liat Beinin Atzili and her husband Aviv, along with his family, begins a frantic mission to save them. Because Liat holds American citizenship, Yehuda travels to the US as part of a delegation urging the American government to secure the hostages' release, but is shocked to realize that the hostages' plight is being used to justify the Israeli government's continuation of the war. While Yehuda, critical of Netanyahu's administration, accuses the prime minister of prolonging the war to avoid imprisonment, some family members and associates push back, arguing that rescue should take priority over criticism. Through the urgent perspective of those longing for the safe return of their loved ones, the film illuminates the complex interplay of politics, history, and divided values. The production includes Darren Aronofsky, director of 'Black Swan,' among its team. It won the Best Documentary Award at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.

director: パスカル・プリッソン
country: フランス 原題または英題：We Have a Dream
synopsis: ハンディキャップを抱えながらも夢を抱き挑戦し続ける、5カ国・6人の子どもたちの姿を追ったドキュメンタリー。 フランスのモードは出生時に片足を切断せざるを得ず、重度の聴覚障がいも抱えながら、バレエや音楽に熱中している。ルワンダに暮らすサビエルは、アルビノであることで好奇のまなざしや身の危険を感じているが、医師になる夢を抱き熱心に勉強している。ネパールのニルマラとケンドはそれぞれ2015年の大地震で片足を失ったが、無二の親友として互いに支え合い、義足でダンスの練習に励む。生まれつき視覚障がいがあるケニアのチャールズは、同じく視覚障がいを持つ伝説のランナーに憧れ、長距離ランナーになる夢を抱く。ブラジルのアントニオは自閉症と注意欠如多動症、聴覚障がいを抱えているが、家族の深い愛情を受け、さまざまなことに興味を持つ。子どもの可能性を信じ、深い愛情とより良い教育環境を与えようと奮闘する親たち、友人として当たり前に手を差し伸べともに学び遊ぶ仲間たち、インクルーシブな支援を模索する教師や周囲の大人たち。子どもたちは身体的・社会的に直面する困難を、家族や仲間たちと共に乗り越えていく。 「世界の果ての通学路」のパスカル・プリッソン監督が、6人の子どもたちの日常や挑戦、家族や仲間たちとの関わりを丁寧に映し出す。
synopsis_en: A documentary following the lives of six children in five countries who, despite their disabilities, continue to dream and take on challenges. In France, Maud, who had one leg amputated at birth and has severe hearing impairment, is passionate about ballet and music. Xavier, living in Rwanda, feels the stares of curiosity and danger because of his albinism, but dreams of becoming a doctor and studies diligently. In Nepal, Nirmala and Khendo each lost a leg in the 2015 earthquake, but as inseparable best friends, they support each other and practice dancing with prosthetic legs. Charles in Kenya, born with a visual impairment, admires a legendary runner who is also visually impaired and dreams of becoming a long-distance runner. Antonio in Brazil has autism, ADHD, and a hearing impairment, but receives deep love from his family and shows interest in various things. The film also portrays parents who believe in their children's potential and strive to give them deep love and a better educational environment, friends who naturally lend a hand and learn and play together, and teachers and other adults seeking inclusive support. The children overcome their physical and social difficulties together with their families and peers. Director Pascal Plisson, known for 'On the Way to School,' carefully captures the daily lives, challenges, and relationships of these six children with their families and friends.
director_jp: パスカル・プリッソン

cinema_name: ヒューマントラストシネマ有楽町

country: スイス
synopsis: 満月の翌朝、スイス各地で10歳の子供が失踪した。男女６人ずつ、４つの言語圏から均等に。警察もメディアも手がかりを掴めぬまま、事件は説明不可能な事態へと発展していく…。
tmdb_overview_en: Fredi M. Murer wrote and directed this Swiss drama about a family with a missing child. The only explanation seems to be kidnapping, but no ransom note arrives. Police inspector Anatol Wasser (Hanspeter Muller) soon faces an elaborate mystery: a dozen Swiss children vanish with no indication of any pattern -- other than the fact that they all lived near lakes. Is organized crime responsible, or does the answer lie in mystical realms? Shown at the 1998 Montreal Film Festival.
synopsis_en: A 1998 fantasy film by Swiss filmmaker Fredi M. Murer, known for 'Höhenfeuer' and 'We, the Mountain People,' which allegorically depicts the mass disappearance of children. Through the form of fantasy, it portrays social issues still relevant today, such as the runaway collective psychology fueled by uncertain information and miscommunication within families. One morning after a full moon, ten-year-old children vanish across Switzerland: six boys and six girls, evenly selected from the four language regions. With police and media unable to find solid leads, the incident develops into an inexplicable situation. Reflecting the contradictions and anxieties lurking in society, the story moves toward the next full moon. Directed and written by Murer, with cinematography by Pio Corradi ('Höhenfeuer') and music by Mario Beretta. Starring Hanspeter Müller, Lilo Bauer, and Benedikt Freitag. It won the Grand Prix at the 1998 Montreal World Film Festival. Released in Japan in 2000, it will receive a special 35mm film screening in 2026 to coincide with the final Japanese screenings of Murer's documentary trilogy, the 'Mountain Trilogy.'

movie_title_en: Beresina or The Last Days of Switzerland
director: ダニエル・シュミット
country: スイス・ドイツ・オーストリア
synopsis: スイスの権力者から愛されるロシア人のコールガール、イリーナ。銀行の頭取、テレビ局の局長などがこぞって彼女の虜になった。中でも特別に彼女を愛したのは、元陸軍少尉のシュトゥルツェネガー。彼は彼女と、過去に彼が結成した秘密軍隊の暗号“ベレジーナ”を使った寸劇遊びに興じる。だがコールガールの彼女を仕切る政治家好きの夫婦は、彼女を利用して国の上層部に受け入れられようと必死になり…。
tmdb_overview_jp: スイスの経済弁護士ヴァルト博士（ウルリヒ・ノエテン）とファッション・デザイナーのシャルロッテ・デー（ジェラルディン・チャップリン）は権力に全ての生きがいを感じる人種で、金融界でも政界でもまともに相手にされてはいなかった。しかし、シャルロッテが抱えるコールガール、ロシア人のイリーナ（エレナ・パノーヴァ）は、権力者たちの寵愛を集めていた。次第に、博士とシャルロッテはそんな彼女に期待と私財をかけ、高級マンションを買い与えるや、彼女に語りかける男たちの機密のやりとりを盗聴しようとする。
tmdb_overview_en: A naive girl's love for Switzerland is put to the test in this satiric comedy. Irina is a woman from Russia who all her life has always been fascinated by Switzerland and longs to live there some day, though her notion of Swiss life has more to do with Heidi and old movies set in the Alps than reality.
movie_title_original: Beresina oder die letzten Tage der Schweiz
synopsis_en: Irina, a Russian call girl beloved by the powerful men of Switzerland. A bank president, a television station director, and others all fall under her spell. Among them, the one who loved her most specially was Sturzenegger, a former army lieutenant. He and she enjoy playing skits using "Berezina," the code name of a secret army he once formed. But the politically minded couple who manage her as a call girl desperately try to use her to gain acceptance into the country's upper echelons...

director: フレディ・M・ムーラー
country: スイス
synopsis: 1988年、NAGRA（ナーグラ：国立放射性廃棄物管理協同組合）はニトヴァルデン準州ヴェレンベルクに原子力発電に使われた核の最終廃棄物処理場を建設する計画を発表し、地域住民の抗議団体が形成される。支持者と反対派にインタビューする。リサーチと議論は、直接影響を被る人々、ヴェレンベルクで数世代にわたって暮らしてきた家族に焦点を当てる。彼らは、放射線の危険性を目前にし、今や自身のルーツと生活の地を奪われることに直面している。さらに本作は、政治家、地質学者、医学者など様々な立場の人々の話から、一過的で限定された地域の問題にとどまらず、時間の尺度としては人間の寿命をはるかに超えたスケールの問題を提起する。ムーラーはこの作品を「子どもたちと子どもたちの子どもたち」に捧げており、次世代に対して責務を負うべき大人たちに、今日にも通じる問いを突きつける。
tmdb_overview_en: The NAGRA (Swiss National Association for the Storage of Radioactive Waste) plans to build a permanent waste disposal site in Wellenberg, Canton of Nidwalden. A regional citizens’ action group is formed to protest against it.
synopsis_en: A documentary by Swiss master director Fredi M. Murer, known for "Mountain Fire," investigating a planned radioactive waste disposal facility in the Alps. It follows both opponents and supporters among the residents trying to protect their roots and land. Murer dedicated this film "to the children and the children's children," posing questions to adults who should bear responsibility for the next generation. Along with "We Mountain People" and "Mountain Fire," it is considered part of the "Mountain Trilogy."

synopsis: かいせつ 脅迫状が届いた人妻に相談された推理小説家は…。複雑な謎と耽美に彩られた乱歩ミステリーを、加藤泰が大胆なエロスと映像表現で描く異色作。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 探偵作家の寒川が静子というファンと出会う。彼女は変革派作家の大江春泥から脅迫されており、ほどなく静子の夫が殺害されて……。江戸川乱歩の「陰獣」を、あおい輝彦、香山美子の顔合わせで映画化したミステリー。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1930, the chance meeting of a novelist and one of his fans opens the door to a series of mysterious events culminating in the death of a wealthy industrialist who may have been leading a double life.
synopsis_en: A mystery novelist consulted by a married woman who has received a threatening letter... Kato Tai boldly depicts Ranpo's mystery, adorned with intricate puzzles and aestheticism, through audacious eroticism and visual expression in this unconventional work.

synopsis: かいせつ 書生・主税と芸者・お蔦の身分違いの悲恋を簡潔かつ情感豊かに描いた名作。雷蔵と名匠・三隅の名コンビによる鏡花原作の五度目の映画化。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: Adaptation of a famous Kyouka Izumi novel. Set in the early 1900's, it tells the story of the impossible love between a young scholar a beautiful geisha.
synopsis_en: A masterpiece that concisely and emotionally depicts the tragic love between a student named Chikara and a geisha named Otsuta, separated by class. The fifth film adaptation of an Izumi Kyoka original, featuring the famed duo of Raizo and master director Misumi.

synopsis: かいせつ 「こんな夢を見た。」で始まる漱石の短編10作をそれぞれ別の監督で映画化。美しくも恐ろしい夢幻の世界を斬新な映像で綴ったオムニバス作品。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 文豪・夏目漱石の異色短編「夢十夜」を、実相寺昭雄、市川崑、清水崇をはじめとする10人の監督が大胆な解釈、奔放なイマジネーションを駆使して映像化した。
tmdb_overview_en: Based on renowned Japanese writer Natsume Soseki's same-titled short story collection, Ten Nights of Dreams brings ten fantastical dream sequences to film with great visual and psychological panache. Representing the combined efforts of eleven directors, this outstanding anthology delves into the surreal subconscious with ten madly imaginative, reality-subverting visions that range from wonderfully wacky to nightmarishly unsettling.
synopsis_en: Ten short stories by Soseki, each beginning with 'I had a dream like this,' are adapted into film by different directors. An omnibus work that weaves a beautiful yet terrifying dreamlike world through innovative imagery.

movie_title_en: Pastoral: To Die in the Country
country: Japan
synopsis: かいせつ 多分野で活躍した演劇界の鬼才・寺山の長編映画第二作。時空を越えた寺山の自伝的原風景を、幻想的で儚い鮮烈なイメージの連続で描く。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 「恐山」「母殺し」「家出」など寺山特有のテーマが多く取り上げられており、自伝的要素が見られるが、劇中劇が用いられるなど虚構の性格が強い作品である。先行して刊行された同名の歌集からの短歌が、映画の中でも朗読される。 菅貫太郎唯一の映画主演作である。ラストシーンは『幕末太陽傳』（の実現しなかった結末案）から影響を受けたといわれる。
tmdb_overview_en: A director faces creative block while working on his latest film – a reimagination of his adolescence growing up in a mountain village in rural Japan.
synopsis_en: An autobiographical work written and directed by Shuji Terayama, adapting his own poetry collection of the same name. In a village at the foot of Mount Osore in Aomori Prefecture, a young boy, 'I', lives with his mother in an old house after losing his father. The boy's only solace is having an itako (a spirit medium) summon his father's spirit to talk to him. A beautiful woman who marries into the neighboring house and a circus troupe that comes to the village tempt the boy to run away from home. Later, 'I' grows up, moves to Tokyo, becomes middle-aged, and makes a film. Before this 'I' appears the boy he once was... Kantaro Suga, known for 'Thirteen Assassins' and others, plays the lead, and Kaoru Yachigusa plays the neighbor's wife.

cinema_address: 神奈川県逗子市新宿1-5-14
director: デビッド・ボレンスタイン
country: デンマーク・チェコ合作 原題または英題：Mr. Nobody Against Putin
synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

cinema_address: 神奈川県逗子市新宿1-5-14
movie_title: ホールディング・リアット
tmdb_overview_en: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.
synopsis_en: A documentary depicting an Israeli-American family's desperate efforts to rescue their daughter abducted by Hamas, crossing divides. On the morning of October 7, 2023, the agricultural community of Nir Oz in southwestern Israel was attacked by Hamas militants, with a quarter of its roughly 400 residents killed or taken hostage. Yehuda, the father of hostage Liat Beinin Atzili and her husband Aviv, along with his family, begins a frantic mission to save them. Because Liat holds American citizenship, Yehuda travels to the US as part of a delegation urging the American government to secure the hostages' release, but is shocked to realize that the hostages' plight is being used to justify the Israeli government's continuation of the war. While Yehuda, critical of Netanyahu's administration, accuses the prime minister of prolonging the war to avoid imprisonment, some family members and associates push back, arguing that rescue should take priority over criticism. Through the urgent perspective of those longing for the safe return of their loved ones, the film illuminates the complex interplay of politics, history, and divided values. The production includes Darren Aronofsky, director of 'Black Swan,' among its team. It won the Best Documentary Award at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.

synopsis_en: A 1998 fantasy film by Swiss filmmaker Fredi M. Murer, known for 'Höhenfeuer' and 'We, the Mountain People,' which allegorically depicts the mass disappearance of children. Through the form of fantasy, it portrays social issues still relevant today, such as the runaway collective psychology fueled by uncertain information and miscommunication within families. One morning after a full moon, ten-year-old children vanish across Switzerland: six boys and six girls, evenly selected from the four language regions. With police and media unable to find solid leads, the incident develops into an inexplicable situation. Reflecting the contradictions and anxieties lurking in society, the story moves toward the next full moon. Directed and written by Murer, with cinematography by Pio Corradi ('Höhenfeuer') and music by Mario Beretta. Starring Hanspeter Müller, Lilo Bauer, and Benedikt Freitag. It won the Grand Prix at the 1998 Montreal World Film Festival. Released in Japan in 2000, it will receive a special 35mm film screening in 2026 to coincide with the final Japanese screenings of Murer's documentary trilogy, the 'Mountain Trilogy.'

movie_title_en: Beresina or The Last Days of Switzerland
director: ダニエル・シュミット
country: スイス・ドイツ・オーストリア
synopsis: スイスの権力者から愛されるロシア人のコールガール、イリーナ。銀行の頭取、テレビ局の局長などがこぞって彼女の虜になった。中でも特別に彼女を愛したのは、元陸軍少尉のシュトゥルツェネガー。彼は彼女と、過去に彼が結成した秘密軍隊の暗号“ベレジーナ”を使った寸劇遊びに興じる。だがコールガールの彼女を仕切る政治家好きの夫婦は、彼女を利用して国の上層部に受け入れられようと必死になり…。
tmdb_overview_jp: スイスの経済弁護士ヴァルト博士（ウルリヒ・ノエテン）とファッション・デザイナーのシャルロッテ・デー（ジェラルディン・チャップリン）は権力に全ての生きがいを感じる人種で、金融界でも政界でもまともに相手にされてはいなかった。しかし、シャルロッテが抱えるコールガール、ロシア人のイリーナ（エレナ・パノーヴァ）は、権力者たちの寵愛を集めていた。次第に、博士とシャルロッテはそんな彼女に期待と私財をかけ、高級マンションを買い与えるや、彼女に語りかける男たちの機密のやりとりを盗聴しようとする。
tmdb_overview_en: A naive girl's love for Switzerland is put to the test in this satiric comedy. Irina is a woman from Russia who all her life has always been fascinated by Switzerland and longs to live there some day, though her notion of Swiss life has more to do with Heidi and old movies set in the Alps than reality.
movie_title_original: Beresina oder die letzten Tage der Schweiz
synopsis_en: Irina, a Russian call girl beloved by the powerful men of Switzerland. A bank president, a television station director, and others all fall under her spell. Among them, the one who loved her most specially was Sturzenegger, a former army lieutenant. He and she enjoy playing skits using "Berezina," the code name of a secret army he once formed. But the politically minded couple who manage her as a call girl desperately try to use her to gain acceptance into the country's upper echelons...

country: スイス
synopsis: 満月の翌朝、スイス各地で10歳の子供が失踪した。男女６人ずつ、４つの言語圏から均等に。警察もメディアも手がかりを掴めぬまま、事件は説明不可能な事態へと発展していく…。
tmdb_overview_en: Fredi M. Murer wrote and directed this Swiss drama about a family with a missing child. The only explanation seems to be kidnapping, but no ransom note arrives. Police inspector Anatol Wasser (Hanspeter Muller) soon faces an elaborate mystery: a dozen Swiss children vanish with no indication of any pattern -- other than the fact that they all lived near lakes. Is organized crime responsible, or does the answer lie in mystical realms? Shown at the 1998 Montreal Film Festival.

director: フレディ・M・ムーラー
country: スイス
synopsis: 1988年、NAGRA（ナーグラ：国立放射性廃棄物管理協同組合）はニトヴァルデン準州ヴェレンベルクに原子力発電に使われた核の最終廃棄物処理場を建設する計画を発表し、地域住民の抗議団体が形成される。支持者と反対派にインタビューする。リサーチと議論は、直接影響を被る人々、ヴェレンベルクで数世代にわたって暮らしてきた家族に焦点を当てる。彼らは、放射線の危険性を目前にし、今や自身のルーツと生活の地を奪われることに直面している。さらに本作は、政治家、地質学者、医学者など様々な立場の人々の話から、一過的で限定された地域の問題にとどまらず、時間の尺度としては人間の寿命をはるかに超えたスケールの問題を提起する。ムーラーはこの作品を「子どもたちと子どもたちの子どもたち」に捧げており、次世代に対して責務を負うべき大人たちに、今日にも通じる問いを突きつける。
tmdb_overview_en: The NAGRA (Swiss National Association for the Storage of Radioactive Waste) plans to build a permanent waste disposal site in Wellenberg, Canton of Nidwalden. A regional citizens’ action group is formed to protest against it.
synopsis_en: A documentary by Swiss master director Fredi M. Murer, known for "Mountain Fire," investigating a planned radioactive waste disposal facility in the Alps. It follows both opponents and supporters among the residents trying to protect their roots and land. Murer dedicated this film "to the children and the children's children," posing questions to adults who should bear responsibility for the next generation. Along with "We Mountain People" and "Mountain Fire," it is considered part of the "Mountain Trilogy."

movie_title_en: Pastoral: To Die in the Country
country: Japan
synopsis: かいせつ 多分野で活躍した演劇界の鬼才・寺山の長編映画第二作。時空を越えた寺山の自伝的原風景を、幻想的で儚い鮮烈なイメージの連続で描く。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 「恐山」「母殺し」「家出」など寺山特有のテーマが多く取り上げられており、自伝的要素が見られるが、劇中劇が用いられるなど虚構の性格が強い作品である。先行して刊行された同名の歌集からの短歌が、映画の中でも朗読される。 菅貫太郎唯一の映画主演作である。ラストシーンは『幕末太陽傳』（の実現しなかった結末案）から影響を受けたといわれる。
tmdb_overview_en: A director faces creative block while working on his latest film – a reimagination of his adolescence growing up in a mountain village in rural Japan.
synopsis_en: An autobiographical work written and directed by Shuji Terayama, adapting his own poetry collection of the same name. In a village at the foot of Mount Osore in Aomori Prefecture, a young boy, 'I', lives with his mother in an old house after losing his father. The boy's only solace is having an itako (a spirit medium) summon his father's spirit to talk to him. A beautiful woman who marries into the neighboring house and a circus troupe that comes to the village tempt the boy to run away from home. Later, 'I' grows up, moves to Tokyo, becomes middle-aged, and makes a film. Before this 'I' appears the boy he once was... Kantaro Suga, known for 'Thirteen Assassins' and others, plays the lead, and Kaoru Yachigusa plays the neighbor's wife.

synopsis: かいせつ 「こんな夢を見た。」で始まる漱石の短編10作をそれぞれ別の監督で映画化。美しくも恐ろしい夢幻の世界を斬新な映像で綴ったオムニバス作品。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 文豪・夏目漱石の異色短編「夢十夜」を、実相寺昭雄、市川崑、清水崇をはじめとする10人の監督が大胆な解釈、奔放なイマジネーションを駆使して映像化した。
tmdb_overview_en: Based on renowned Japanese writer Natsume Soseki's same-titled short story collection, Ten Nights of Dreams brings ten fantastical dream sequences to film with great visual and psychological panache. Representing the combined efforts of eleven directors, this outstanding anthology delves into the surreal subconscious with ten madly imaginative, reality-subverting visions that range from wonderfully wacky to nightmarishly unsettling.
synopsis_en: Ten short stories by Soseki, each beginning with 'I had a dream like this,' are adapted into film by different directors. An omnibus work that weaves a beautiful yet terrifying dreamlike world through innovative imagery.

synopsis: かいせつ 書生・主税と芸者・お蔦の身分違いの悲恋を簡潔かつ情感豊かに描いた名作。雷蔵と名匠・三隅の名コンビによる鏡花原作の五度目の映画化。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: Adaptation of a famous Kyouka Izumi novel. Set in the early 1900's, it tells the story of the impossible love between a young scholar a beautiful geisha.
synopsis_en: A masterpiece that concisely and emotionally depicts the tragic love between a student named Chikara and a geisha named Otsuta, separated by class. The fifth film adaptation of an Izumi Kyoka original, featuring the famed duo of Raizo and master director Misumi.

synopsis: かいせつ 脅迫状が届いた人妻に相談された推理小説家は…。複雑な謎と耽美に彩られた乱歩ミステリーを、加藤泰が大胆なエロスと映像表現で描く異色作。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 探偵作家の寒川が静子というファンと出会う。彼女は変革派作家の大江春泥から脅迫されており、ほどなく静子の夫が殺害されて……。江戸川乱歩の「陰獣」を、あおい輝彦、香山美子の顔合わせで映画化したミステリー。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1930, the chance meeting of a novelist and one of his fans opens the door to a series of mysterious events culminating in the death of a wealthy industrialist who may have been leading a double life.
synopsis_en: A mystery novelist consulted by a married woman who has received a threatening letter... Kato Tai boldly depicts Ranpo's mystery, adorned with intricate puzzles and aestheticism, through audacious eroticism and visual expression in this unconventional work.

cinema_address: 神奈川県逗子市新宿1-5-14
director: デビッド・ボレンスタイン
country: デンマーク・チェコ合作 原題または英題：Mr. Nobody Against Putin
synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

cinema_address: 神奈川県逗子市新宿1-5-14
movie_title: ホールディング・リアット
tmdb_overview_en: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.
synopsis_en: A documentary depicting an Israeli-American family's desperate efforts to rescue their daughter abducted by Hamas, crossing divides. On the morning of October 7, 2023, the agricultural community of Nir Oz in southwestern Israel was attacked by Hamas militants, with a quarter of its roughly 400 residents killed or taken hostage. Yehuda, the father of hostage Liat Beinin Atzili and her husband Aviv, along with his family, begins a frantic mission to save them. Because Liat holds American citizenship, Yehuda travels to the US as part of a delegation urging the American government to secure the hostages' release, but is shocked to realize that the hostages' plight is being used to justify the Israeli government's continuation of the war. While Yehuda, critical of Netanyahu's administration, accuses the prime minister of prolonging the war to avoid imprisonment, some family members and associates push back, arguing that rescue should take priority over criticism. Through the urgent perspective of those longing for the safe return of their loved ones, the film illuminates the complex interplay of politics, history, and divided values. The production includes Darren Aronofsky, director of 'Black Swan,' among its team. It won the Best Documentary Award at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.

cinema_address: 神奈川県逗子市新宿1-5-14
movie_title: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
movie_title_jp: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
director: パスカル・プリッソン
country: フランス 原題または英題：We Have a Dream
synopsis: ハンディキャップを抱えながらも夢を抱き挑戦し続ける、5カ国・6人の子どもたちの姿を追ったドキュメンタリー。 フランスのモードは出生時に片足を切断せざるを得ず、重度の聴覚障がいも抱えながら、バレエや音楽に熱中している。ルワンダに暮らすサビエルは、アルビノであることで好奇のまなざしや身の危険を感じているが、医師になる夢を抱き熱心に勉強している。ネパールのニルマラとケンドはそれぞれ2015年の大地震で片足を失ったが、無二の親友として互いに支え合い、義足でダンスの練習に励む。生まれつき視覚障がいがあるケニアのチャールズは、同じく視覚障がいを持つ伝説のランナーに憧れ、長距離ランナーになる夢を抱く。ブラジルのアントニオは自閉症と注意欠如多動症、聴覚障がいを抱えているが、家族の深い愛情を受け、さまざまなことに興味を持つ。子どもの可能性を信じ、深い愛情とより良い教育環境を与えようと奮闘する親たち、友人として当たり前に手を差し伸べともに学び遊ぶ仲間たち、インクルーシブな支援を模索する教師や周囲の大人たち。子どもたちは身体的・社会的に直面する困難を、家族や仲間たちと共に乗り越えていく。 「世界の果ての通学路」のパスカル・プリッソン監督が、6人の子どもたちの日常や挑戦、家族や仲間たちとの関わりを丁寧に映し出す。
synopsis_en: A documentary following the lives of six children in five countries who, despite their disabilities, continue to dream and take on challenges. In France, Maud, who had one leg amputated at birth and has severe hearing impairment, is passionate about ballet and music. Xavier, living in Rwanda, feels the stares of curiosity and danger because of his albinism, but dreams of becoming a doctor and studies diligently. In Nepal, Nirmala and Khendo each lost a leg in the 2015 earthquake, but as inseparable best friends, they support each other and practice dancing with prosthetic legs. Charles in Kenya, born with a visual impairment, admires a legendary runner who is also visually impaired and dreams of becoming a long-distance runner. Antonio in Brazil has autism, ADHD, and a hearing impairment, but receives deep love from his family and shows interest in various things. The film also portrays parents who believe in their children's potential and strive to give them deep love and a better educational environment, friends who naturally lend a hand and learn and play together, and teachers and other adults seeking inclusive support. The children overcome their physical and social difficulties together with their families and peers. Director Pascal Plisson, known for 'On the Way to School,' carefully captures the daily lives, challenges, and relationships of these six children with their families and friends.
director_jp: パスカル・プリッソン

movie_title_en: Shepherds' Journey into the Third Millennium
director: エリッヒ・ラングヤール
country: スイス
synopsis: スイスの羊飼い一家の日々の営みをアルプスの山々を背景に描く。何百頭もの羊の群れ。雪のなか牧草を求めてさまよい、車が行き交う道路を横断する。子羊の出産とそれを見つめる妻や子ども、乳搾りやパン作りの毎日。世界最古の職業のひとつであるといわれる羊飼いの、実際は過酷な労働でもある生活を見つめる。
tmdb_overview_en: Director Erich Langjahr follows several of the last remaining shepherds in Switzerland, on the cusp of the third millennium. How does one of the oldest human means of subsistence survive into the modern age? At an unhurried pace, he captures the shepherd, his sheep, his dogs and his mules as they trudge across snow-covered fields, climb mountain passes and cross highways. The sheep have to be cared for all year round and the life of a shepherd is physically demanding. Shepherds stay outdoors, or in small huts and caravans – often in places inaccessible by car. During their long periods away from home, their families expand and their children grow up. But they wouldn’t have it any other way; being a shepherd is a very conscious life choice. One of them puts it like this: “I just can’t sit still. As long as my health allows me I’ll always be on the go. No matter where in the world, I’d like to be on the go forever.”
synopsis_en: A portrait of the daily life of a Swiss shepherd family set against the backdrop of the Alps. A flock of hundreds of sheep. Wandering through snow in search of pasture, crossing roads busy with traffic. The birth of lambs and the wife and children watching over them, the daily routines of milking and bread-making. The film observes the life of shepherds—said to be one of the world's oldest professions—which is in reality also grueling labor.

director: デビッド・ボレンスタイン
country: デンマーク・チェコ合作 原題または英題：Mr. Nobody Against Putin
synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

movie_title: ホールディング・リアット
tmdb_overview_en: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.
synopsis_en: A documentary depicting an Israeli-American family's desperate efforts to rescue their daughter abducted by Hamas, crossing divides. On the morning of October 7, 2023, the agricultural community of Nir Oz in southwestern Israel was attacked by Hamas militants, with a quarter of its roughly 400 residents killed or taken hostage. Yehuda, the father of hostage Liat Beinin Atzili and her husband Aviv, along with his family, begins a frantic mission to save them. Because Liat holds American citizenship, Yehuda travels to the US as part of a delegation urging the American government to secure the hostages' release, but is shocked to realize that the hostages' plight is being used to justify the Israeli government's continuation of the war. While Yehuda, critical of Netanyahu's administration, accuses the prime minister of prolonging the war to avoid imprisonment, some family members and associates push back, arguing that rescue should take priority over criticism. Through the urgent perspective of those longing for the safe return of their loved ones, the film illuminates the complex interplay of politics, history, and divided values. The production includes Darren Aronofsky, director of 'Black Swan,' among its team. It won the Best Documentary Award at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.

cinema_address: 神奈川県逗子市新宿1-5-14
movie_title: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
movie_title_jp: ウィー・ハブ・ア・ドリーム
director: パスカル・プリッソン
country: フランス 原題または英題：We Have a Dream
synopsis: ハンディキャップを抱えながらも夢を抱き挑戦し続ける、5カ国・6人の子どもたちの姿を追ったドキュメンタリー。 フランスのモードは出生時に片足を切断せざるを得ず、重度の聴覚障がいも抱えながら、バレエや音楽に熱中している。ルワンダに暮らすサビエルは、アルビノであることで好奇のまなざしや身の危険を感じているが、医師になる夢を抱き熱心に勉強している。ネパールのニルマラとケンドはそれぞれ2015年の大地震で片足を失ったが、無二の親友として互いに支え合い、義足でダンスの練習に励む。生まれつき視覚障がいがあるケニアのチャールズは、同じく視覚障がいを持つ伝説のランナーに憧れ、長距離ランナーになる夢を抱く。ブラジルのアントニオは自閉症と注意欠如多動症、聴覚障がいを抱えているが、家族の深い愛情を受け、さまざまなことに興味を持つ。子どもの可能性を信じ、深い愛情とより良い教育環境を与えようと奮闘する親たち、友人として当たり前に手を差し伸べともに学び遊ぶ仲間たち、インクルーシブな支援を模索する教師や周囲の大人たち。子どもたちは身体的・社会的に直面する困難を、家族や仲間たちと共に乗り越えていく。 「世界の果ての通学路」のパスカル・プリッソン監督が、6人の子どもたちの日常や挑戦、家族や仲間たちとの関わりを丁寧に映し出す。
synopsis_en: A documentary following the lives of six children in five countries who, despite their disabilities, continue to dream and take on challenges. In France, Maud, who had one leg amputated at birth and has severe hearing impairment, is passionate about ballet and music. Xavier, living in Rwanda, feels the stares of curiosity and danger because of his albinism, but dreams of becoming a doctor and studies diligently. In Nepal, Nirmala and Khendo each lost a leg in the 2015 earthquake, but as inseparable best friends, they support each other and practice dancing with prosthetic legs. Charles in Kenya, born with a visual impairment, admires a legendary runner who is also visually impaired and dreams of becoming a long-distance runner. Antonio in Brazil has autism, ADHD, and a hearing impairment, but receives deep love from his family and shows interest in various things. The film also portrays parents who believe in their children's potential and strive to give them deep love and a better educational environment, friends who naturally lend a hand and learn and play together, and teachers and other adults seeking inclusive support. The children overcome their physical and social difficulties together with their families and peers. Director Pascal Plisson, known for 'On the Way to School,' carefully captures the daily lives, challenges, and relationships of these six children with their families and friends.
director_jp: パスカル・プリッソン

movie_title_en: Shepherds' Journey into the Third Millennium
director: エリッヒ・ラングヤール
country: スイス
synopsis: スイスの羊飼い一家の日々の営みをアルプスの山々を背景に描く。何百頭もの羊の群れ。雪のなか牧草を求めてさまよい、車が行き交う道路を横断する。子羊の出産とそれを見つめる妻や子ども、乳搾りやパン作りの毎日。世界最古の職業のひとつであるといわれる羊飼いの、実際は過酷な労働でもある生活を見つめる。
tmdb_overview_en: Director Erich Langjahr follows several of the last remaining shepherds in Switzerland, on the cusp of the third millennium. How does one of the oldest human means of subsistence survive into the modern age? At an unhurried pace, he captures the shepherd, his sheep, his dogs and his mules as they trudge across snow-covered fields, climb mountain passes and cross highways. The sheep have to be cared for all year round and the life of a shepherd is physically demanding. Shepherds stay outdoors, or in small huts and caravans – often in places inaccessible by car. During their long periods away from home, their families expand and their children grow up. But they wouldn’t have it any other way; being a shepherd is a very conscious life choice. One of them puts it like this: “I just can’t sit still. As long as my health allows me I’ll always be on the go. No matter where in the world, I’d like to be on the go forever.”
synopsis_en: A portrait of the daily life of a Swiss shepherd family set against the backdrop of the Alps. A flock of hundreds of sheep. Wandering through snow in search of pasture, crossing roads busy with traffic. The birth of lambs and the wife and children watching over them, the daily routines of milking and bread-making. The film observes the life of shepherds—said to be one of the world's oldest professions—which is in reality also grueling labor.

director: フレディ・M・ムーラー
country: スイス
synopsis: 1988年、NAGRA（ナーグラ：国立放射性廃棄物管理協同組合）はニトヴァルデン準州ヴェレンベルクに原子力発電に使われた核の最終廃棄物処理場を建設する計画を発表し、地域住民の抗議団体が形成される。支持者と反対派にインタビューする。リサーチと議論は、直接影響を被る人々、ヴェレンベルクで数世代にわたって暮らしてきた家族に焦点を当てる。彼らは、放射線の危険性を目前にし、今や自身のルーツと生活の地を奪われることに直面している。さらに本作は、政治家、地質学者、医学者など様々な立場の人々の話から、一過的で限定された地域の問題にとどまらず、時間の尺度としては人間の寿命をはるかに超えたスケールの問題を提起する。ムーラーはこの作品を「子どもたちと子どもたちの子どもたち」に捧げており、次世代に対して責務を負うべき大人たちに、今日にも通じる問いを突きつける。
tmdb_overview_en: The NAGRA (Swiss National Association for the Storage of Radioactive Waste) plans to build a permanent waste disposal site in Wellenberg, Canton of Nidwalden. A regional citizens’ action group is formed to protest against it.
synopsis_en: A documentary by Swiss master director Fredi M. Murer, known for "Mountain Fire," investigating a planned radioactive waste disposal facility in the Alps. It follows both opponents and supporters among the residents trying to protect their roots and land. Murer dedicated this film "to the children and the children's children," posing questions to adults who should bear responsibility for the next generation. Along with "We Mountain People" and "Mountain Fire," it is considered part of the "Mountain Trilogy."

synopsis: かいせつ 書生・主税と芸者・お蔦の身分違いの悲恋を簡潔かつ情感豊かに描いた名作。雷蔵と名匠・三隅の名コンビによる鏡花原作の五度目の映画化。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: Adaptation of a famous Kyouka Izumi novel. Set in the early 1900's, it tells the story of the impossible love between a young scholar a beautiful geisha.
synopsis_en: A masterpiece that concisely and emotionally depicts the tragic love between a student named Chikara and a geisha named Otsuta, separated by class. The fifth film adaptation of an Izumi Kyoka original, featuring the famed duo of Raizo and master director Misumi.

movie_title_en: Pastoral: To Die in the Country
country: Japan
synopsis: かいせつ 多分野で活躍した演劇界の鬼才・寺山の長編映画第二作。時空を越えた寺山の自伝的原風景を、幻想的で儚い鮮烈なイメージの連続で描く。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 「恐山」「母殺し」「家出」など寺山特有のテーマが多く取り上げられており、自伝的要素が見られるが、劇中劇が用いられるなど虚構の性格が強い作品である。先行して刊行された同名の歌集からの短歌が、映画の中でも朗読される。 菅貫太郎唯一の映画主演作である。ラストシーンは『幕末太陽傳』（の実現しなかった結末案）から影響を受けたといわれる。
tmdb_overview_en: A director faces creative block while working on his latest film – a reimagination of his adolescence growing up in a mountain village in rural Japan.
synopsis_en: An autobiographical work written and directed by Shuji Terayama, adapting his own poetry collection of the same name. In a village at the foot of Mount Osore in Aomori Prefecture, a young boy, 'I', lives with his mother in an old house after losing his father. The boy's only solace is having an itako (a spirit medium) summon his father's spirit to talk to him. A beautiful woman who marries into the neighboring house and a circus troupe that comes to the village tempt the boy to run away from home. Later, 'I' grows up, moves to Tokyo, becomes middle-aged, and makes a film. Before this 'I' appears the boy he once was... Kantaro Suga, known for 'Thirteen Assassins' and others, plays the lead, and Kaoru Yachigusa plays the neighbor's wife.

synopsis: かいせつ 脅迫状が届いた人妻に相談された推理小説家は…。複雑な謎と耽美に彩られた乱歩ミステリーを、加藤泰が大胆なエロスと映像表現で描く異色作。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 探偵作家の寒川が静子というファンと出会う。彼女は変革派作家の大江春泥から脅迫されており、ほどなく静子の夫が殺害されて……。江戸川乱歩の「陰獣」を、あおい輝彦、香山美子の顔合わせで映画化したミステリー。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1930, the chance meeting of a novelist and one of his fans opens the door to a series of mysterious events culminating in the death of a wealthy industrialist who may have been leading a double life.
synopsis_en: A mystery novelist consulted by a married woman who has received a threatening letter... Kato Tai boldly depicts Ranpo's mystery, adorned with intricate puzzles and aestheticism, through audacious eroticism and visual expression in this unconventional work.

synopsis: かいせつ 「こんな夢を見た。」で始まる漱石の短編10作をそれぞれ別の監督で映画化。美しくも恐ろしい夢幻の世界を斬新な映像で綴ったオムニバス作品。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_jp: 文豪・夏目漱石の異色短編「夢十夜」を、実相寺昭雄、市川崑、清水崇をはじめとする10人の監督が大胆な解釈、奔放なイマジネーションを駆使して映像化した。
tmdb_overview_en: Based on renowned Japanese writer Natsume Soseki's same-titled short story collection, Ten Nights of Dreams brings ten fantastical dream sequences to film with great visual and psychological panache. Representing the combined efforts of eleven directors, this outstanding anthology delves into the surreal subconscious with ten madly imaginative, reality-subverting visions that range from wonderfully wacky to nightmarishly unsettling.
synopsis_en: Ten short stories by Soseki, each beginning with 'I had a dream like this,' are adapted into film by different directors. An omnibus work that weaves a beautiful yet terrifying dreamlike world through innovative imagery.

synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

movie_title: ホールディング・リアット
tmdb_overview_en: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.
synopsis_en: A documentary depicting an Israeli-American family's desperate efforts to rescue their daughter abducted by Hamas, crossing divides. On the morning of October 7, 2023, the agricultural community of Nir Oz in southwestern Israel was attacked by Hamas militants, with a quarter of its roughly 400 residents killed or taken hostage. Yehuda, the father of hostage Liat Beinin Atzili and her husband Aviv, along with his family, begins a frantic mission to save them. Because Liat holds American citizenship, Yehuda travels to the US as part of a delegation urging the American government to secure the hostages' release, but is shocked to realize that the hostages' plight is being used to justify the Israeli government's continuation of the war. While Yehuda, critical of Netanyahu's administration, accuses the prime minister of prolonging the war to avoid imprisonment, some family members and associates push back, arguing that rescue should take priority over criticism. Through the urgent perspective of those longing for the safe return of their loved ones, the film illuminates the complex interplay of politics, history, and divided values. The production includes Darren Aronofsky, director of 'Black Swan,' among its team. It won the Best Documentary Award at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.

country: フランス 原題または英題：We Have a Dream
synopsis: ハンディキャップを抱えながらも夢を抱き挑戦し続ける、5カ国・6人の子どもたちの姿を追ったドキュメンタリー。 フランスのモードは出生時に片足を切断せざるを得ず、重度の聴覚障がいも抱えながら、バレエや音楽に熱中している。ルワンダに暮らすサビエルは、アルビノであることで好奇のまなざしや身の危険を感じているが、医師になる夢を抱き熱心に勉強している。ネパールのニルマラとケンドはそれぞれ2015年の大地震で片足を失ったが、無二の親友として互いに支え合い、義足でダンスの練習に励む。生まれつき視覚障がいがあるケニアのチャールズは、同じく視覚障がいを持つ伝説のランナーに憧れ、長距離ランナーになる夢を抱く。ブラジルのアントニオは自閉症と注意欠如多動症、聴覚障がいを抱えているが、家族の深い愛情を受け、さまざまなことに興味を持つ。子どもの可能性を信じ、深い愛情とより良い教育環境を与えようと奮闘する親たち、友人として当たり前に手を差し伸べともに学び遊ぶ仲間たち、インクルーシブな支援を模索する教師や周囲の大人たち。子どもたちは身体的・社会的に直面する困難を、家族や仲間たちと共に乗り越えていく。 「世界の果ての通学路」のパスカル・プリッソン監督が、6人の子どもたちの日常や挑戦、家族や仲間たちとの関わりを丁寧に映し出す。
synopsis_en: A documentary following the lives of six children in five countries who, despite their disabilities, continue to dream and take on challenges. In France, Maud, who had one leg amputated at birth and has severe hearing impairment, is passionate about ballet and music. Xavier, living in Rwanda, feels the stares of curiosity and danger because of his albinism, but dreams of becoming a doctor and studies diligently. In Nepal, Nirmala and Khendo each lost a leg in the 2015 earthquake, but as inseparable best friends, they support each other and practice dancing with prosthetic legs. Charles in Kenya, born with a visual impairment, admires a legendary runner who is also visually impaired and dreams of becoming a long-distance runner. Antonio in Brazil has autism, ADHD, and a hearing impairment, but receives deep love from his family and shows interest in various things. The film also portrays parents who believe in their children's potential and strive to give them deep love and a better educational environment, friends who naturally lend a hand and learn and play together, and teachers and other adults seeking inclusive support. The children overcome their physical and social difficulties together with their families and peers. Director Pascal Plisson, known for 'On the Way to School,' carefully captures the daily lives, challenges, and relationships of these six children with their families and friends.

tmdb_overview_jp: 探偵作家の寒川が静子というファンと出会う。彼女は変革派作家の大江春泥から脅迫されており、ほどなく静子の夫が殺害されて……。江戸川乱歩の「陰獣」を、あおい輝彦、香山美子の顔合わせで映画化したミステリー。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1930, the chance meeting of a novelist and one of his fans opens the door to a series of mysterious events culminating in the death of a wealthy industrialist who may have been leading a double life.
synopsis_en: A mystery novelist consulted by a married woman who has received a threatening letter... Kato Tai boldly depicts Ranpo's mystery, adorned with intricate puzzles and aestheticism, through audacious eroticism and visual expression in this unconventional work.

country: デンマーク・チェコ合作 原題または英題：Mr. Nobody Against Putin
synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

movie_title: ホールディング・リアット
tmdb_overview_en: Liat Atzili was kidnapped from her kibbutz on October 7. What begins as a chronicle of her parents, sister, and children's efforts to secure her return, becomes a portrait of conflicting impulses towards anger, indifference, and compassion straining the bonds of one grieving family.
synopsis_en: A documentary depicting an Israeli-American family's desperate efforts to rescue their daughter abducted by Hamas, crossing divides. On the morning of October 7, 2023, the agricultural community of Nir Oz in southwestern Israel was attacked by Hamas militants, with a quarter of its roughly 400 residents killed or taken hostage. Yehuda, the father of hostage Liat Beinin Atzili and her husband Aviv, along with his family, begins a frantic mission to save them. Because Liat holds American citizenship, Yehuda travels to the US as part of a delegation urging the American government to secure the hostages' release, but is shocked to realize that the hostages' plight is being used to justify the Israeli government's continuation of the war. While Yehuda, critical of Netanyahu's administration, accuses the prime minister of prolonging the war to avoid imprisonment, some family members and associates push back, arguing that rescue should take priority over criticism. Through the urgent perspective of those longing for the safe return of their loved ones, the film illuminates the complex interplay of politics, history, and divided values. The production includes Darren Aronofsky, director of 'Black Swan,' among its team. It won the Best Documentary Award at the 75th Berlin International Film Festival in 2025.

country: フランス 原題または英題：We Have a Dream
synopsis: ハンディキャップを抱えながらも夢を抱き挑戦し続ける、5カ国・6人の子どもたちの姿を追ったドキュメンタリー。 フランスのモードは出生時に片足を切断せざるを得ず、重度の聴覚障がいも抱えながら、バレエや音楽に熱中している。ルワンダに暮らすサビエルは、アルビノであることで好奇のまなざしや身の危険を感じているが、医師になる夢を抱き熱心に勉強している。ネパールのニルマラとケンドはそれぞれ2015年の大地震で片足を失ったが、無二の親友として互いに支え合い、義足でダンスの練習に励む。生まれつき視覚障がいがあるケニアのチャールズは、同じく視覚障がいを持つ伝説のランナーに憧れ、長距離ランナーになる夢を抱く。ブラジルのアントニオは自閉症と注意欠如多動症、聴覚障がいを抱えているが、家族の深い愛情を受け、さまざまなことに興味を持つ。子どもの可能性を信じ、深い愛情とより良い教育環境を与えようと奮闘する親たち、友人として当たり前に手を差し伸べともに学び遊ぶ仲間たち、インクルーシブな支援を模索する教師や周囲の大人たち。子どもたちは身体的・社会的に直面する困難を、家族や仲間たちと共に乗り越えていく。 「世界の果ての通学路」のパスカル・プリッソン監督が、6人の子どもたちの日常や挑戦、家族や仲間たちとの関わりを丁寧に映し出す。
synopsis_en: A documentary following the lives of six children in five countries who, despite their disabilities, continue to dream and take on challenges. In France, Maud, who had one leg amputated at birth and has severe hearing impairment, is passionate about ballet and music. Xavier, living in Rwanda, feels the stares of curiosity and danger because of his albinism, but dreams of becoming a doctor and studies diligently. In Nepal, Nirmala and Khendo each lost a leg in the 2015 earthquake, but as inseparable best friends, they support each other and practice dancing with prosthetic legs. Charles in Kenya, born with a visual impairment, admires a legendary runner who is also visually impaired and dreams of becoming a long-distance runner. Antonio in Brazil has autism, ADHD, and a hearing impairment, but receives deep love from his family and shows interest in various things. The film also portrays parents who believe in their children's potential and strive to give them deep love and a better educational environment, friends who naturally lend a hand and learn and play together, and teachers and other adults seeking inclusive support. The children overcome their physical and social difficulties together with their families and peers. Director Pascal Plisson, known for 'On the Way to School,' carefully captures the daily lives, challenges, and relationships of these six children with their families and friends.

synopsis: ある夜、ワヒドが働く工房に、野良犬と衝突事故を起こした家族連れの男が車の修理を求めてやってくる。その男が義足を引きずる奇妙な音を耳にした瞬間、ワヒドの脳裏に忌まわしい過去が蘇る。かつて政治犯として不当に投獄されたワヒドは、“義足”というあだ名で恐れられた看守エグバルから残忍な拷問を受け、人生の大切なものすべてを奪われてしまったのだ。ガレージに現れた義足の男こそはエグバルだと確信したワヒドは、翌日、強引に拉致した彼を荒野に生き埋めにしようとする。しかし、エグバルの顔を見たことがないワヒドの心に迷いが生じる。一旦報復を取りやめたワヒドは、同じトラウマを抱える元囚人たちのもとを訪ねるが、誰も義足の男がエグバル本人だとは証明できない。やがてワヒドらがもくろむ復讐殺人は、思いがけない事態へと迷走していくのだった……。
tmdb_overview_jp: かつて不当な理由で投獄されたワヒドは、ある偶然によって、自分の人生を奪った看守に出会う。咄嗟に男を拘束し、荒野に穴を掘り埋めようとするが、男は人違いだと言う。実はワヒドは、男の顔を見たことがなかった。男は、本当に復讐の相手なのか？一旦復讐を中断し、同じ男に拷問された友人を訪ねることにするが･･･。
tmdb_overview_en: An unassuming mechanic is reminded of his time in an Iranian prison when he encounters a man he suspects to be his sadistic jailhouse captor.

movie_title_jp: シンプル・アクシデント／偶然
synopsis_en: A suspense thriller by Iranian master Jafar Panahi, winner of the Palme d'Or at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. It thrillingly and humorously depicts people wrongfully imprisoned seeking revenge. Vahid, once unjustly imprisoned, accidentally encounters a man he believes was his torturer guard. He forcibly restrains the man and digs a hole in the wilderness to bury him, but the man's ID card shows a different name. The man claims it's a case of mistaken identity. Blindfolded during imprisonment, Vahid never saw his torturer's face. Unsure if this is the right man, Vahid pauses revenge and visits a friend who was also tortured by the same guard. Panahi, banned from filmmaking by the Iranian government for opposition activities, drew inspiration from his own two imprisonments and the real voices of cellmates. Having won the Golden Lion at Venice for 'The Circle' and 'No Bears', and the Golden Bear at Berlin for 'Taxi', Panahi achieved the feat of winning top prizes at all three major festivals with this film. A French co-production, it was France's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards and received a nomination.

movie_title: デッドマンズ・ワイヤー
director: ガス・ヴァン・サント
country: アメリカ
synopsis: 1977年、インディアナ州。不動産ローン会社に押し入ったトニー・キリシスは社長の息子ディックを人質に取って、“デッドマンズ・ワイヤー”という自動発砲装置を自分と人質の首に固定する。「すべてを奪われた」と訴え立てこもる彼の要求は、金銭的補償と“社長からの謝罪”だった。動くに動けない警察が事態の打開を図る一方、彼は人気ラジオ番組へ電話したりTVでの記者会見を要求したりと予測不能な行動に出て事態は混迷を極める。前代未聞の極限状態に世間は騒然、賛否が巻き起こる中、ついに社長と電話がつながるのだが――。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1977, former real estate developer Tony Kiritsis puts a dead man's switch on himself and the mortgage banker who did him wrong, demanding $5 million and a personal apology.
clean_title_jp: デッドマンズ・ワイヤー
movie_title_jp: デッドマンズ・ワイヤー
director_jp: ガス・ヴァン・サント
synopsis_en: Tony Kiritsis (Bill Skarsgård), a middle-aged single man living in Indianapolis, believing he was swindled out of his entire life savings by the mortgage company Meridian Mortgage, breaks into their office and takes the president's son and executive, Dick Hall (Dacre Montgomery), hostage. Using a device called a "dead man's wire"—a shotgun and wire rigged to his and the hostage's necks so that any sudden movement would trigger the gun—he demands an apology and compensation from the company. With the local police completely unable to act, Tony calls a popular radio show to expose Meridian Mortgage's wrongdoing, involving the show's DJ Fred Temple (Coleman Domingo) to broadcast his claims. The mortgage company's representative issues a statement on TV accepting Tony's demands, but Tony refuses, insisting that the president, M.L. Hall, must apologize in person first. As the situation shows no sign of improvement, the FBI arrives and begins profiling Tony, while police prepare for a raid. Suspicion of a bomb on the scene brings in a bomb squad, tightening the net around Tony. Meanwhile, Tony's next move is to call in the three major US networks and other media to the scene, holding a press conference with the dead man's wire still pointed at Dick. Tony's appeal through the media divides public opinion and throws America into chaos.

country: スペイン・フランス合作 原題または英題：Sirāt
synopsis: 失踪した娘を捜すため砂漠のレイブパーティに参加した父と息子の旅の行方を、奇想天外なストーリーとクールなダンスミュージックを融合させて描き、本国スペインをはじめヨーロッパ各国で話題を集めたロードムービー。 ルイスは砂漠でのレイブパーティに参加したまま行方がわからなくなった娘を捜すため、息子エステバンとともにモロッコの山岳地帯から砂漠の奥地へと車を走らせる。やがて彼らは現実と幻覚が混濁するような野外レイブ会場にたどり着くが、そこにはすでに娘の姿はなかった。父子はレイブの参加者グループを追い、娘が向かったと思われる次のレイブ会場を目指すが……。 父ルイス役に「パンズ・ラビリンス」のセルジ・ロペス。「ファイアー・ウィル・カム」のオリベル・ラシェが監督・脚本を手がけ、製作にはスペインを代表する名匠ペドロ・アルモドバルが名を連ねた。タイトルの「シラート」はアラビア語で「道」を意味し、宗教的な意味においては審判の日に天国と地獄の上に架けられる細い橋を象徴するとされる。2025年・第78回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、審査員賞など4冠に輝いた。第98回アカデミー賞では国際長編映画賞と音響賞にノミネート。
tmdb_overview_jp: 砂漠で行われるレイブパーティに参加したまま失踪した娘を探すため、父ルイスと息子エステバンは、モロッコの山岳地帯から砂漠の奥深くへと車を走らせる。行き着いたのは、現実と幻覚が混濁するような野外レイブのカオス。耳をつんざく重低音、赤い照明の海、沈黙を貫く父親の背中。だがそこにはすでに娘の姿はなく、父と息子は、レイブの参加者グループを追って、娘が向かったと思われる次のレイブ会場を目指すことになるが......。
tmdb_overview_en: A man and his son arrive at a rave lost in the mountains of Morocco. They are looking for Marina, their daughter and sister, who disappeared months ago at another rave. Driven by fate, they decide to follow a group of ravers in search of one last party, in hopes Marina will be there.
synopsis_en: This road movie, blending a fantastical story with cool dance music, follows a father and son's journey through a desert rave party in search of a missing daughter, sparking buzz across Spain and Europe. Luis drives with his son Esteban from the Moroccan mountains deep into the desert to find his daughter, who disappeared after attending a desert rave. They reach an outdoor rave site where reality and hallucination blur, but she is not there. The father and son chase a group of ravers, heading to the next rave site where they believe she went. Sergi López ("Pan's Labyrinth") plays father Luis. Directed and written by Oliver Laxe ("Fire Will Come"), the film is produced by renowned Spanish master Pedro Almodóvar. The title "Siraat" means "path" in Arabic and, in a religious sense, symbolizes the narrow bridge over heaven and hell on Judgment Day. Screened in the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025, it won four awards including the Jury Prize. synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

tmdb_overview_jp: 香港に存在する4大トレイル・コース（総距離298キロ、獲得標高14,500m）を制限時間以内に走り切らなければならない、という超過酷なイベント【香港フォー・トレイルズ・ウルトラ・チャレンジ】。  60時間以内にゴールした者には「FINISHER(完走者)」、72時間以内の者には「SURVIVOR（生還者）」の称号が与えられるそのレースに出走した18人のランナーたちの極限に挑む姿と、これまで見る機会がほとんどなかった香港の美しい大自然を余すところなく収めた感動のドキュメンタリー。  香港では2024年末、小規模で公開が始まり、瞬く間に口コミが拡がって上映館数が増え、大スター チョウ・ユンファも「すべての香港人が観るべき」と大絶賛。スポーツ愛好者のみならず一般映画ファンにも支持されて15万人を動員する2025年最大のサプライズ・ヒットとなりました。  香港に生まれ育った英国人監督ロビン・リーが2年以上を費やして編集。香港電影金像奨 新人監督賞を受賞、編集賞にもノミネート。観る者は、ランナーたちが繰り広げるドラマに胸を熱くし、やがては香港という街に息づく不屈のエネルギーをも感じることが出来るでしょう。

synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge, commonly known as HK4TUC, requires runners to consecutively complete four trail courses in Hong Kong and reach the finish line within a time limit of 72 hours (3 days). The total course length is 298 km, comparable to the distance between Tokyo and Nagoya, with a cumulative elevation gain of 14,500 m, equivalent to seven full marathons or two ascents of Mount Everest. Furthermore, participants must procure their own water and food from shops along the way, and strict rules prohibit the use of poles or portable music players, which would be advantageous on the undulating mountain paths. It is an event of extreme physical and mental challenge. This film captures 18 runners who took on the HK4TUC pushing their limits, set against the beautiful natural landscapes of Hong Kong, rarely seen before. The director is Robin Lee, a British director born and raised in Hong Kong. The film began a limited release in Hong Kong at the end of 2024, but word-of-mouth spread rapidly and the number of screens increased sharply. It gained further attention when the major star Chow Yun-fat, known for the 'A Better Tomorrow' series and 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon', highly praised it, saying 'every Hong Kong person should watch it'. Supported not only by sports enthusiasts but also by general film fans, it became the biggest surprise hit of 2025, attracting 150,000 viewers. Additionally, it has won numerous awards, including the Best New Director Award at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, the Audience Award at the 22nd Hong Kong Asian Film Festival, the Recommended Film Award at the 31st Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards, and the Jury Special Award at the 2025 Hong Kong Directors' Guild Awards, earning high praise as a documentary.

synopsis: ある夜、ワヒドが働く工房に、野良犬と衝突事故を起こした家族連れの男が車の修理を求めてやってくる。その男が義足を引きずる奇妙な音を耳にした瞬間、ワヒドの脳裏に忌まわしい過去が蘇る。かつて政治犯として不当に投獄されたワヒドは、“義足”というあだ名で恐れられた看守エグバルから残忍な拷問を受け、人生の大切なものすべてを奪われてしまったのだ。ガレージに現れた義足の男こそはエグバルだと確信したワヒドは、翌日、強引に拉致した彼を荒野に生き埋めにしようとする。しかし、エグバルの顔を見たことがないワヒドの心に迷いが生じる。一旦報復を取りやめたワヒドは、同じトラウマを抱える元囚人たちのもとを訪ねるが、誰も義足の男がエグバル本人だとは証明できない。やがてワヒドらがもくろむ復讐殺人は、思いがけない事態へと迷走していくのだった……。
tmdb_overview_jp: かつて不当な理由で投獄されたワヒドは、ある偶然によって、自分の人生を奪った看守に出会う。咄嗟に男を拘束し、荒野に穴を掘り埋めようとするが、男は人違いだと言う。実はワヒドは、男の顔を見たことがなかった。男は、本当に復讐の相手なのか？一旦復讐を中断し、同じ男に拷問された友人を訪ねることにするが･･･。

synopsis_en: A suspense thriller by Iranian master Jafar Panahi, winner of the Palme d'Or at the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025. It thrillingly and humorously depicts people wrongfully imprisoned seeking revenge. Vahid, once unjustly imprisoned, accidentally encounters a man he believes was his torturer guard. He forcibly restrains the man and digs a hole in the wilderness to bury him, but the man's ID card shows a different name. The man claims it's a case of mistaken identity. Blindfolded during imprisonment, Vahid never saw his torturer's face. Unsure if this is the right man, Vahid pauses revenge and visits a friend who was also tortured by the same guard. Panahi, banned from filmmaking by the Iranian government for opposition activities, drew inspiration from his own two imprisonments and the real voices of cellmates. Having won the Golden Lion at Venice for 'The Circle' and 'No Bears', and the Golden Bear at Berlin for 'Taxi', Panahi achieved the feat of winning top prizes at all three major festivals with this film. A French co-production, it was France's entry for Best International Feature Film at the 98th Academy Awards and received a nomination.

synopsis: 1977年、インディアナ州。不動産ローン会社に押し入ったトニー・キリシスは社長の息子ディックを人質に取って、“デッドマンズ・ワイヤー”という自動発砲装置を自分と人質の首に固定する。「すべてを奪われた」と訴え立てこもる彼の要求は、金銭的補償と“社長からの謝罪”だった。動くに動けない警察が事態の打開を図る一方、彼は人気ラジオ番組へ電話したりTVでの記者会見を要求したりと予測不能な行動に出て事態は混迷を極める。前代未聞の極限状態に世間は騒然、賛否が巻き起こる中、ついに社長と電話がつながるのだが――。

director_jp: ガス・ヴァン・サント
synopsis_en: Tony Kiritsis (Bill Skarsgård), a middle-aged single man living in Indianapolis, believing he was swindled out of his entire life savings by the mortgage company Meridian Mortgage, breaks into their office and takes the president's son and executive, Dick Hall (Dacre Montgomery), hostage. Using a device called a "dead man's wire"—a shotgun and wire rigged to his and the hostage's necks so that any sudden movement would trigger the gun—he demands an apology and compensation from the company. With the local police completely unable to act, Tony calls a popular radio show to expose Meridian Mortgage's wrongdoing, involving the show's DJ Fred Temple (Coleman Domingo) to broadcast his claims. The mortgage company's representative issues a statement on TV accepting Tony's demands, but Tony refuses, insisting that the president, M.L. Hall, must apologize in person first. As the situation shows no sign of improvement, the FBI arrives and begins profiling Tony, while police prepare for a raid. Suspicion of a bomb on the scene brings in a bomb squad, tightening the net around Tony. Meanwhile, Tony's next move is to call in the three major US networks and other media to the scene, holding a press conference with the dead man's wire still pointed at Dick. Tony's appeal through the media divides public opinion and throws America into chaos.

synopsis: 失踪した娘を捜すため砂漠のレイブパーティに参加した父と息子の旅の行方を、奇想天外なストーリーとクールなダンスミュージックを融合させて描き、本国スペインをはじめヨーロッパ各国で話題を集めたロードムービー。 ルイスは砂漠でのレイブパーティに参加したまま行方がわからなくなった娘を捜すため、息子エステバンとともにモロッコの山岳地帯から砂漠の奥地へと車を走らせる。やがて彼らは現実と幻覚が混濁するような野外レイブ会場にたどり着くが、そこにはすでに娘の姿はなかった。父子はレイブの参加者グループを追い、娘が向かったと思われる次のレイブ会場を目指すが……。 父ルイス役に「パンズ・ラビリンス」のセルジ・ロペス。「ファイアー・ウィル・カム」のオリベル・ラシェが監督・脚本を手がけ、製作にはスペインを代表する名匠ペドロ・アルモドバルが名を連ねた。タイトルの「シラート」はアラビア語で「道」を意味し、宗教的な意味においては審判の日に天国と地獄の上に架けられる細い橋を象徴するとされる。2025年・第78回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、審査員賞など4冠に輝いた。第98回アカデミー賞では国際長編映画賞と音響賞にノミネート。
tmdb_overview_jp: 砂漠で行われるレイブパーティに参加したまま失踪した娘を探すため、父ルイスと息子エステバンは、モロッコの山岳地帯から砂漠の奥深くへと車を走らせる。行き着いたのは、現実と幻覚が混濁するような野外レイブのカオス。耳をつんざく重低音、赤い照明の海、沈黙を貫く父親の背中。だがそこにはすでに娘の姿はなく、父と息子は、レイブの参加者グループを追って、娘が向かったと思われる次のレイブ会場を目指すことになるが......。
tmdb_overview_en: A man and his son arrive at a rave lost in the mountains of Morocco. They are looking for Marina, their daughter and sister, who disappeared months ago at another rave. Driven by fate, they decide to follow a group of ravers in search of one last party, in hopes Marina will be there.
synopsis_en: This road movie, blending a fantastical story with cool dance music, follows a father and son's journey through a desert rave party in search of a missing daughter, sparking buzz across Spain and Europe. Luis drives with his son Esteban from the Moroccan mountains deep into the desert to find his daughter, who disappeared after attending a desert rave. They reach an outdoor rave site where reality and hallucination blur, but she is not there. The father and son chase a group of ravers, heading to the next rave site where they believe she went. Sergi López ("Pan's Labyrinth") plays father Luis. Directed and written by Oliver Laxe ("Fire Will Come"), the film is produced by renowned Spanish master Pedro Almodóvar. The title "Siraat" means "path" in Arabic and, in a religious sense, symbolizes the narrow bridge over heaven and hell on Judgment Day. Screened in the Competition section of the 78th Cannes Film Festival in 2025, it won four awards including the Jury Prize. It was nominated for the Academy Awards for Best International Feature Film and Best Sound at the 98th Academy Awards.

synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

tmdb_overview_jp: 香港に存在する4大トレイル・コース（総距離298キロ、獲得標高14,500m）を制限時間以内に走り切らなければならない、という超過酷なイベント【香港フォー・トレイルズ・ウルトラ・チャレンジ】。  60時間以内にゴールした者には「FINISHER(完走者)」、72時間以内の者には「SURVIVOR（生還者）」の称号が与えられるそのレースに出走した18人のランナーたちの極限に挑む姿と、これまで見る機会がほとんどなかった香港の美しい大自然を余すところなく収めた感動のドキュメンタリー。  香港では2024年末、小規模で公開が始まり、瞬く間に口コミが拡がって上映館数が増え、大スター チョウ・ユンファも「すべての香港人が観るべき」と大絶賛。スポーツ愛好者のみならず一般映画ファンにも支持されて15万人を動員する2025年最大のサプライズ・ヒットとなりました。  香港に生まれ育った英国人監督ロビン・リーが2年以上を費やして編集。香港電影金像奨 新人監督賞を受賞、編集賞にもノミネート。観る者は、ランナーたちが繰り広げるドラマに胸を熱くし、やがては香港という街に息づく不屈のエネルギーをも感じることが出来るでしょう。
