synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge, commonly known as HK4TUC, requires runners to consecutively complete four trail courses in Hong Kong and reach the finish line within a time limit of 72 hours (3 days). The total course length is 298 km, comparable to the distance between Tokyo and Nagoya, with a cumulative elevation gain of 14,500 m, equivalent to seven full marathons or two ascents of Mount Everest. Furthermore, participants must procure their own water and food from shops along the way, and strict rules prohibit the use of poles or portable music players, which would be advantageous on the undulating mountain paths. It is an event of extreme physical and mental challenge. This film captures 18 runners who took on the HK4TUC pushing their limits, set against the beautiful natural landscapes of Hong Kong, rarely seen before. The director is Robin Lee, a British director born and raised in Hong Kong. The film began a limited release in Hong Kong at the end of 2024, but word-of-mouth spread rapidly and the number of screens increased sharply. It gained further attention when the major star Chow Yun-fat, known for the 'A Better Tomorrow' series and 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon', highly praised it, saying 'every Hong Kong person should watch it'. Supported not only by sports enthusiasts but also by general film fans, it became the biggest surprise hit of 2025, attracting 150,000 viewers. Additionally, it has won numerous awards, including the Best New Director Award at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, the Audience Award at the 22nd Hong Kong Asian Film Festival, the Recommended Film Award at the 31st Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards, and the Jury Special Award at the 2025 Hong Kong Directors' Guild Awards, earning high praise as a documentary.

synopsis: ウクライナ侵攻後からロシアで行われている愛国教育の全貌を暴いたドキュメンタリー。 ロシア・ウラル山脈のふもとにある小さな田舎町カラバシュ。小学校でイベントの企画や撮影を担当する教員パベル・タランキンは、子どもたちの何気ない日常や成長の瞬間をビデオカメラに収める平穏な日々を送っていた。自由と民主主義を愛する彼は、自身の職業を心から誇りに思っていた。しかし2022年2月、ロシアによるウクライナ侵攻が始まると、彼らの日常は一変する。プーチン大統領は子どもたちを「未来の兵士」として育てるため、戦争を賛美し参加するよう学校で教える「愛国教育」の導入を発令。和やかだった学校の雰囲気は、瞬く間に戦時下の緊迫した空気へと塗り替えられる。逆らう者は国家の敵と見なされる絶対的な命令のもと葛藤する教師たち、戦時教育に染まっていく子どもたち、次々と戦地へ送られる卒業生たち。タランキンのカメラは、そのすべてを記録していく。 デンマークを拠点に活動するアメリカ人ドキュメンタリー作家デビッド・ボレンスタインがパベル・タランキンと共同で監督を務め、国家が市民を扇動し戦時下へと突き進んでいくプロパガンダの実態を、当事者の視点から鮮明に映し出す。2026年・第98回アカデミー賞で長編ドキュメンタリー賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

tmdb_overview_jp: 香港に存在する4大トレイル・コース（総距離298キロ、獲得標高14,500m）を制限時間以内に走り切らなければならない、という超過酷なイベント【香港フォー・トレイルズ・ウルトラ・チャレンジ】。  60時間以内にゴールした者には「FINISHER(完走者)」、72時間以内の者には「SURVIVOR（生還者）」の称号が与えられるそのレースに出走した18人のランナーたちの極限に挑む姿と、これまで見る機会がほとんどなかった香港の美しい大自然を余すところなく収めた感動のドキュメンタリー。  香港では2024年末、小規模で公開が始まり、瞬く間に口コミが拡がって上映館数が増え、大スター チョウ・ユンファも「すべての香港人が観るべき」と大絶賛。スポーツ愛好者のみならず一般映画ファンにも支持されて15万人を動員する2025年最大のサプライズ・ヒットとなりました。  香港に生まれ育った英国人監督ロビン・リーが2年以上を費やして編集。香港電影金像奨 新人監督賞を受賞、編集賞にもノミネート。観る者は、ランナーたちが繰り広げるドラマに胸を熱くし、やがては香港という街に息づく不屈のエネルギーをも感じることが出来るでしょう。

synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge, commonly known as HK4TUC, requires runners to consecutively complete four trail courses in Hong Kong and reach the finish line within a time limit of 72 hours (3 days). The total course length is 298 km, comparable to the distance between Tokyo and Nagoya, with a cumulative elevation gain of 14,500 m, equivalent to seven full marathons or two ascents of Mount Everest. Furthermore, participants must procure their own water and food from shops along the way, and strict rules prohibit the use of poles or portable music players, which would be advantageous on the undulating mountain paths. It is an event of extreme physical and mental challenge. This film captures 18 runners who took on the HK4TUC pushing their limits, set against the beautiful natural landscapes of Hong Kong, rarely seen before. The director is Robin Lee, a British director born and raised in Hong Kong. The film began a limited release in Hong Kong at the end of 2024, but word-of-mouth spread rapidly and the number of screens increased sharply. It gained further attention when the major star Chow Yun-fat, known for the 'A Better Tomorrow' series and 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon', highly praised it, saying 'every Hong Kong person should watch it'. Supported not only by sports enthusiasts but also by general film fans, it became the biggest surprise hit of 2025, attracting 150,000 viewers. Additionally, it has won numerous awards, including the Best New Director Award at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, the Audience Award at the 22nd Hong Kong Asian Film Festival, the Recommended Film Award at the 31st Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards, and the Jury Special Award at the 2025 Hong Kong Directors' Guild Awards, earning high praise as a documentary.

synopsis: 日本で女優として長篇劇映画のプロダクションを初めて興した入江たか子の主演作で、入江ぷろと木村の協働が生んだ重要作。寒村から南方に出稼ぎにいった多くの女性のひとり、おゆき（入江）は、西欧人との間に生まれた子どもをつれて故郷に帰る。しかし、村の男たちは彼女を差別し、お金を搾取することしか考えていなかった。2人の苦難と、同じ境遇の女性たちとの連帯が、アイデアに満ちた鮮烈な演出で描かれる。
tmdb_overview_en: "Karayuki-san offers a no-holds-barred depiction of the discrimination faced by a former prostitute who returns to Japan from Singapore with her mixed-race son." - Alexander Jacoby (Oxford Brookes University)
synopsis_en: A starring vehicle for Takako Irie, who became the first woman in Japan to establish a production company for feature-length narrative films, this is an important work born from the collaboration between Irie Productions and Kimura. Oyuki (Irie), one of many women who left her impoverished village to work in the South Seas, returns home with a child born from a relationship with a Western man. However, the village men discriminate against her and think only of exploiting her money. The hardships of the two and their solidarity with women in the same situation are depicted through vivid, idea-rich direction.

synopsis: 中国戦線で軍医から故郷の牧場を託された3人は、閉鎖を企む高利貸しから牧場を守ろうと従業員一同と奮闘する。国家総動員法成立と同年の公開で、銃後の意識の啓発を企図して製作された。生産の場を働く者たちの共同体として捉え、資本の脅威に対抗するさまが、社会主義的とも評された『麦秋』（キング・ヴィダー、1934）も彷彿とさせ興味深い。本作でデビューの江波和子は、高利貸しの社長令嬢であるヒロインを演じている。
synopsis_en: Three men entrusted with their hometown ranch by an army doctor on the China front struggle alongside all the employees to protect the ranch from a moneylender plotting to shut it down. Released in the same year the National Mobilization Law was enacted, it was produced with the intent of raising home-front awareness. It is fascinating how the production site is conceived as a community of workers resisting the threat of capital, evoking King Vidor's Our Daily Bread (1934), which was also described as socialist. Kazuko Enami, making her debut in this film, plays the heroine, the daughter of the moneylender company's president.

tmdb_overview_en: As Russia launches its full-scale invasion of Ukraine, primary schools across Russia’s hinterlands are transformed into recruitment stages for the war. Facing the ethical dilemma of working in a system defined by propaganda and violence, a brave teacher goes undercover to film what’s really happening in his own school.
synopsis_en: A documentary exposing the full scope of the patriotic education being carried out in Russia since the invasion of Ukraine. In Karabash, a small rural town at the foot of Russia's Ural Mountains, Pavel Tarankin, a schoolteacher in charge of planning and filming events at the elementary school, led a peaceful life capturing the children's everyday moments and growth on his video camera. A lover of freedom and democracy, he was genuinely proud of his profession. But in February 2022, when Russia's invasion of Ukraine began, their daily lives were transformed. President Putin issued a decree introducing "patriotic education" that teaches children in schools to glorify and take part in war, raising them as "future soldiers." The once gentle atmosphere of the school was instantly repainted with the tense air of wartime. Under absolute orders in which anyone who defies is seen as an enemy of the state, teachers struggle with their consciences, children become steeped in wartime education, and graduates are sent off to the front one after another. Tarankin's camera records it all. American documentary filmmaker David Borenstein, based in Denmark, co-directs with Pavel Tarankin, vividly capturing from the perspective of those involved the reality of propaganda as a state incites its citizens and drives them toward war. It won the Best Documentary Feature award at the 98th Academy Awards in 2026.

synopsis_en: The Hong Kong Four Trails Ultra Challenge, commonly known as HK4TUC, requires runners to consecutively complete four trail courses in Hong Kong and reach the finish line within a time limit of 72 hours (3 days). The total course length is 298 km, comparable to the distance between Tokyo and Nagoya, with a cumulative elevation gain of 14,500 m, equivalent to seven full marathons or two ascents of Mount Everest. Furthermore, participants must procure their own water and food from shops along the way, and strict rules prohibit the use of poles or portable music players, which would be advantageous on the undulating mountain paths. It is an event of extreme physical and mental challenge. This film captures 18 runners who took on the HK4TUC pushing their limits, set against the beautiful natural landscapes of Hong Kong, rarely seen before. The director is Robin Lee, a British director born and raised in Hong Kong. The film began a limited release in Hong Kong at the end of 2024, but word-of-mouth spread rapidly and the number of screens increased sharply. It gained further attention when the major star Chow Yun-fat, known for the 'A Better Tomorrow' series and 'Crouching Tiger, Hidden Dragon', highly praised it, saying 'every Hong Kong person should watch it'. Supported not only by sports enthusiasts but also by general film fans, it became the biggest surprise hit of 2025, attracting 150,000 viewers. Additionally, it has won numerous awards, including the Best New Director Award at the 43rd Hong Kong Film Awards, the Audience Award at the 22nd Hong Kong Asian Film Festival, the Recommended Film Award at the 31st Hong Kong Film Critics Society Awards, and the Jury Special Award at the 2025 Hong Kong Directors' Guild Awards, earning high praise as a documentary.

synopsis: 広島平和記念公園の「原爆の子の像」建立までの実話に着想を得た作品。原爆症を患い入院した小学6年生の貞子（菅井）。貞子と同級生たちは回復を願って鶴を折るが、やがて貞子は帰らぬ人に。中学に進学した子どもたちは貞子をモデルにした像を建てるべく活動を始める。実際に像の建設運動が進む最中に現地でロケーション撮影を敢行、ラストには除幕式の光景が映し出される。
synopsis_en: Inspired by the true story behind the erection of the "Children's Peace Monument" in Hiroshima Peace Memorial Park. Sadako (Sugai), a sixth-grader who falls ill with radiation sickness and is hospitalized, folds cranes with her classmates in hopes of recovery, but eventually Sadako passes away. The children, now in junior high, begin a campaign to build a statue modeled after Sadako. Location shooting was carried out on site while the actual statue construction movement was underway, and the final scene shows the unveiling ceremony.

program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
tmdb_overview_en: What is the life of a Geisha like once her beauty has faded and she has retired? Kin has saved, and become a wealthy money-lender, spending her days coldly collecting debts. Even her best friends, fellow Geisha Tomi, Nobu, and Tamae, are now indebted to her. For all of them, the glamour of their young lives has passed; Tomi and Tamae have disappointing children. Kin has two former lovers who still pursue her; one she wants to see, and the other she doesn't. But even the one she remembers fondly, when he shows up, proves less than satisfactory.
synopsis_en: A celebrated film depicting the respective sorrows of middle-aged women who were once fellow geisha. The masterful performances woven together by four veteran actresses—Sugimura, Mochizuki, Sawamura, and Hosokawa—are deeply moving.

movie_title: 『女ばかりの夜』 ＊デジタル上映
synopsis: かいせつ 売春防止法施行後、更生施設に収容された娼婦たちが新たな人生を切り開くため苦闘する姿を描いた社会派女性映画。沢村は施設の職員役。
program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
tmdb_overview_jp: 昭和三十三年、売春防止法が施行された。巧みに法の網の目を潜って春を売る女は、依然として後を断たなかった。しかし、警察のきびしい取締りで検挙された彼女たちは、強制的に厚生寮か補導院へ送られ、そこで一定の補導期間を終えて更生への途に踏み出すのだが、彼女たちを迎える社会は意外に冷たく、想像できない困難が待ち受けていた。白菊婦人寮もそうした施設の一つで、邦子、チエ子、亀寿、小雪ら三十三人の女が収容されていた。彼女たちは、野上、北村、岡田など数人の寮母の熱心な指導のもとで、規律ある毎日の生活を送っていた。模範生邦子は、職安の斡旋で食料品店に勤める身となった。が、ある日、米屋の洩らした一言から他の店員が彼女の過去を知り、主人の妻よしにそれを告げ口された。それからというものは、差別待遇、軽侮と敵意に満ちた態度に苦しめられる毎日が続いた。一夜、よしの留守中に主人の達吉を誘惑、日頃のよしへの仕返しに強いて過ちを犯した邦子は、あてもなく街に出た。以前の悪い血がふたたび騒ぎはじめた。刑事に捕えられた彼女は、寮母野上と警察の保護室で再会した。野上の世話で今度は精機会社の女工になった。食料品では前身を隠していたため苦い思いをさせられたので、この職場では前身を同僚に打ち明けた。ところが、意外にも女工たちの余りにも常軌を逸した私生活に、邦子は呆然となった。安い賃金で働かされている彼女たちは、性の欲求と衣類や化粧品を得るための一挙両得を狙って、街の若者たちにセックスを売っているのだった。しかも、真面目に生きようとする邦子は、彼女　をある男に提供しようと図った同僚きみ子に反抗したことから、倉庫の中で残酷なリンチを受けた。邦子はそれでも挫けることなく、志摩夫人のバラ園に仕事を見つけて、学生食堂に勤める同僚チエとお寺の離れを借りた。邦子は幸福だった。園芸技師の早川は彼女の前身を知りながらも、愛情をもって接してくれた。早川は邦子と結婚の約束をし、やがてその承諾を得るため、郷里の母の許へ向かった。一日千秋の思いで邦子は待ったが、早川の母から志摩夫人あてに、体を売っていた女と息子を結婚させるわけにはいかない、という手紙が届いた。幾日かの後、房総のある海辺で海女となってまめまめしく働く邦子の姿が見られた。
tmdb_overview_en: In the wake of the 1956 Prostitution Prevention Law, a young woman recently released from one of Japan's new rehabilitation centers struggles to build a new life.

synopsis: かいせつ かつて芸者仲間だった熟年の女たちの、それぞれの悲哀を描いた名篇。杉村、望月、沢村、細川、四人のベテラン女優が織り成す名演が胸を打つ。
program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
tmdb_overview_en: What is the life of a Geisha like once her beauty has faded and she has retired? Kin has saved, and become a wealthy money-lender, spending her days coldly collecting debts. Even her best friends, fellow Geisha Tomi, Nobu, and Tamae, are now indebted to her. For all of them, the glamour of their young lives has passed; Tomi and Tamae have disappointing children. Kin has two former lovers who still pursue her; one she wants to see, and the other she doesn't. But even the one she remembers fondly, when he shows up, proves less than satisfactory.
synopsis_en: A celebrated film depicting the respective sorrows of middle-aged women who were once fellow geisha. The masterful performances woven together by four veteran actresses—Sugimura, Mochizuki, Sawamura, and Hosokawa—are deeply moving.

synopsis: かいせつ 壊れゆく貞淑な人妻の悲劇を、実験的な映像を用いて描く、異色の官能ミステリー。沢村は、その演技の幅の広さを見せつける怪演ぶり！
program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
tmdb_overview_en: During the war a university professor meets a girl and marries her. Very soon however, it is apparent that their needs are not matched. He would much rather be translating Shakespeare than attending to her, and she has a secret in her past - one that results in her sleeping with a great number of men.

movie_title: 『女ばかりの夜』 ＊デジタル上映
synopsis: かいせつ 売春防止法施行後、更生施設に収容された娼婦たちが新たな人生を切り開くため苦闘する姿を描いた社会派女性映画。沢村は施設の職員役。
program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
tmdb_overview_jp: 昭和三十三年、売春防止法が施行された。巧みに法の網の目を潜って春を売る女は、依然として後を断たなかった。しかし、警察のきびしい取締りで検挙された彼女たちは、強制的に厚生寮か補導院へ送られ、そこで一定の補導期間を終えて更生への途に踏み出すのだが、彼女たちを迎える社会は意外に冷たく、想像できない困難が待ち受けていた。白菊婦人寮もそうした施設の一つで、邦子、チエ子、亀寿、小雪ら三十三人の女が収容されていた。彼女たちは、野上、北村、岡田など数人の寮母の熱心な指導のもとで、規律ある毎日の生活を送っていた。模範生邦子は、職安の斡旋で食料品店に勤める身となった。が、ある日、米屋の洩らした一言から他の店員が彼女の過去を知り、主人の妻よしにそれを告げ口された。それからというものは、差別待遇、軽侮と敵意に満ちた態度に苦しめられる毎日が続いた。一夜、よしの留守中に主人の達吉を誘惑、日頃のよしへの仕返しに強いて過ちを犯した邦子は、あてもなく街に出た。以前の悪い血がふたたび騒ぎはじめた。刑事に捕えられた彼女は、寮母野上と警察の保護室で再会した。野上の世話で今度は精機会社の女工になった。食料品では前身を隠していたため苦い思いをさせられたので、この職場では前身を同僚に打ち明けた。ところが、意外にも女工たちの余りにも常軌を逸した私生活に、邦子は呆然となった。安い賃金で働かされている彼女たちは、性の欲求と衣類や化粧品を得るための一挙両得を狙って、街の若者たちにセックスを売っているのだった。しかも、真面目に生きようとする邦子は、彼女　をある男に提供しようと図った同僚きみ子に反抗したことから、倉庫の中で残酷なリンチを受けた。邦子はそれでも挫けることなく、志摩夫人のバラ園に仕事を見つけて、学生食堂に勤める同僚チエとお寺の離れを借りた。邦子は幸福だった。園芸技師の早川は彼女の前身を知りながらも、愛情をもって接してくれた。早川は邦子と結婚の約束をし、やがてその承諾を得るため、郷里の母の許へ向かった。一日千秋の思いで邦子は待ったが、早川の母から志摩夫人あてに、体を売っていた女と息子を結婚させるわけにはいかない、という手紙が届いた。幾日かの後、房総のある海辺で海女となってまめまめしく働く邦子の姿が見られた。
tmdb_overview_en: In the wake of the 1956 Prostitution Prevention Law, a young woman recently released from one of Japan's new rehabilitation centers struggles to build a new life.
synopsis_en: A socially conscious women's film depicting prostitutes who, after the enforcement of the Anti-Prostitution Law, are placed in rehabilitation facilities and struggle to carve out new lives for themselves. Sawamura plays a staff member at the facility.

program_title: 没後30年 女優・沢村貞子を探して ——稀代の名脇役の軌跡を辿る
synopsis_en: A masterpiece of human drama previously filmed with Bando Tsumasaburo, Mifune Toshiro, and Katsu Shintaro; in this Toei version, Mikuni energetically plays Matsugoro. Sawamura plays the proprietress of an inn.
